SELECT 
    p.player_name, 
    SUM(b.bowler_runs) * 1.0 / COUNT(w.wicket_id) AS bowling_average
FROM 
    wicket_taken w
JOIN 
    ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id 
        AND w.inning_no = b.inning_no 
        AND w.over_id = b.over_id 
        AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
JOIN 
    player p ON w.bowler = p.player_id
GROUP BY 
    w.bowler, p.player_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(w.wicket_id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1;

treatment.sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored,0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs,0)) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS bowling_average
FROM 
    wicket_taken wt
JOIN 
    ball_by_ball bbb ON wt.match_id = bbb.match_id AND wt.innings_no = bbb.innings_no 
                         AND wt.over_id = bbb.over_id AND wt.ball_id = bbb.ball_id
JOIN 
    player p ON bbb.bowler = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN 
    batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no 
                       AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
LEFT JOIN 
    extra_runs er ON bbb.match_id = er.match_id AND bbb.innings_no = er.innings_no 
                   AND bbb.over_id = er.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = er.ball_id
GROUP BY 
    p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH monthly_balance AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', transaction_date) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'deposit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'withdrawal' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS month_end_balance
  FROM bitcoin_transactions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', transaction_date) = '2020'
  GROUP BY customer_id, month
),
positive_balance_counts AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS positive_customer_count
  FROM monthly_balance
  WHERE month_end_balance > 0
  GROUP BY month
),
extreme_months AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT month FROM positive_balance_counts ORDER BY positive_customer_count DESC, month ASC LIMIT 1) AS max_month,
    (SELECT month FROM positive_balance_counts ORDER BY positive_customer_count ASC, month ASC LIMIT 1) AS min_month
),
avg_balance_per_extreme_month AS (
  SELECT
    mb.month,
    AVG(mb.month_end_balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM monthly_balance mb
  JOIN extreme_months em
    ON mb.month = em.max_month OR mb.month = em.min_month
  GROUP BY mb.month
)
SELECT
  em.max_month AS month_with_most_positive_balances,
  em.min_month AS month_with_least_positive_balances,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ab.month = em.max_month THEN ab.avg_balance END) AS avg_balance_max_month,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ab.month = em.min_month THEN ab.avg_balance END) AS avg_balance_min_month,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ab.month = em.max_month THEN ab.avg_balance END) - 
    MAX(CASE WHEN ab.month = em.min_month THEN ab.avg_balance END) AS avg_balance_difference
FROM extreme_months em
JOIN avg_balance_per_extreme_month ab
  ON ab.month = em.max_month OR ab.month = em.min_month
;

WITH month_txns AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS ym,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS deposits,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS withdrawals
  FROM customer_transactions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', txn_date) = '2020'
  GROUP BY customer_id, ym
),
month_balances AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    ym,
    deposits - withdrawals AS month_end_balance
  FROM month_txns
),
month_positive_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ym,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS positive_count
  FROM month_balances
  WHERE month_end_balance > 0
  GROUP BY ym
),
extreme_months AS (
  SELECT
    'max' AS tag,
    ym,
    positive_count
  FROM month_positive_counts
  WHERE positive_count = (SELECT MAX(positive_count) FROM month_positive_counts)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'min' AS tag,
    ym,
    positive_count
  FROM month_positive_counts
  WHERE positive_count = (SELECT MIN(positive_count) FROM month_positive_counts)
  LIMIT 2
),
month_avgs AS (
  SELECT
    e.tag,
    e.ym,
    AVG(b.month_end_balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM extreme_months e
  JOIN month_balances b ON b.ym = e.ym
  GROUP BY e.tag, e.ym
)
SELECT
  (SELECT avg_balance FROM month_avgs WHERE tag = 'max') -
  (SELECT avg_balance FROM month_avgs WHERE tag = 'min') AS avg_balance_difference,
  (SELECT ym FROM month_avgs WHERE tag = 'max') AS month_highest_positive_customers,
  (SELECT avg_balance FROM month_avgs WHERE tag = 'max') AS avg_balance_highest,
  (SELECT ym FROM month_avgs WHERE tag = 'min') AS month_lowest_positive_customers,
  (SELECT avg_balance FROM month_avgs WHERE tag = 'min') AS avg_balance_lowest
;

WITH 
-- Get each legislator's first term start date and filter for the cohort
cohort AS (
  SELECT
    l.id AS legislator_id,
    MIN(lt.start_date) AS first_term_start
  FROM legislators l
  JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id = lt.legislator_id
  WHERE DATE(lt.start_date) BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31'
  GROUP BY l.id
),

-- For each legislator in cohort, get max office end date across all terms
cohort_with_end AS (
  SELECT
    c.legislator_id,
    c.first_term_start,
    MAX(lt.end_date) AS last_term_end
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN legislators_terms lt ON c.legislator_id = lt.legislator_id
  GROUP BY c.legislator_id, c.first_term_start
),

-- Build all 20 retention 'years' (0 to 19) for each legislator
all_years AS (
  SELECT
    cwe.legislator_id,
    cwe.first_term_start,
    cwe.last_term_end,
    y.year_idx,
    DATE(cwe.first_term_start, printf('+%d years','0')) AS year0,
    DATE(cwe.first_term_start, printf('+%d years', y.year_idx)) AS cohort_year_date
  FROM cohort_with_end cwe
  JOIN (SELECT 0 as year_idx UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL
              SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL
              SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL
              SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19) y
),

-- Determine, for each legislator and year, if in office on Dec 31 of that year
retention_flags AS (
  SELECT
    ay.year_idx,
    ay.cohort_year_date,
    ay.legislator_id,
    ay.first_term_start,
    ay.last_term_end,
    -- Find the Dec 31 date for the Nth cohort year
    DATE(STRFTIME('%Y', ay.cohort_year_date) || '-12-31') AS year_end_date,
    -- Retained if last_term_end is null or after this year_end_date
    CASE
      WHEN (ay.last_term_end IS NULL OR DATE(ay.last_term_end) >= DATE(STRFTIME('%Y', ay.cohort_year_date) || '-12-31'))
           AND DATE(ay.first_term_start) <= DATE(STRFTIME('%Y', ay.cohort_year_date) || '-12-31')
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained
  FROM all_years ay
),

-- Compute denominators (cohort size)
cohort_size AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT legislator_id) AS n_cohort FROM cohort
)

SELECT
  rf.year_idx + 1 AS year_number,
  rf.year_end_date,
  ROUND(1.0 * SUM(rf.retained) / cs.n_cohort, 4) AS retention_rate
FROM retention_flags rf
CROSS JOIN cohort_size cs
GROUP BY rf.year_idx, rf.year_end_date
ORDER BY rf.year_idx
LIMIT 20;

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT
        l.id_bioguide,
        MIN(lt.term_start) AS first_term_start
    FROM
        legislators l
        JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE
        DATE(lt.term_start) BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31'
    GROUP BY
        l.id_bioguide
),
periods AS (
    SELECT 1 AS period
    UNION ALL SELECT 2
    UNION ALL SELECT 3
    UNION ALL SELECT 4
    UNION ALL SELECT 5
    UNION ALL SELECT 6
    UNION ALL SELECT 7
    UNION ALL SELECT 8
    UNION ALL SELECT 9
    UNION ALL SELECT 10
    UNION ALL SELECT 11
    UNION ALL SELECT 12
    UNION ALL SELECT 13
    UNION ALL SELECT 14
    UNION ALL SELECT 15
    UNION ALL SELECT 16
    UNION ALL SELECT 17
    UNION ALL SELECT 18
    UNION ALL SELECT 19
    UNION ALL SELECT 20
),
cohort_size AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM cohort
),
retention AS (
    SELECT
        p.period,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.id_bioguide) AS retained
    FROM periods p
    CROSS JOIN cohort c
    LEFT JOIN legislators_terms lt
      ON lt.id_bioguide = c.id_bioguide
      AND DATE(lt.term_start) <= DATE(c.first_term_start, '+' || p.period || ' years', '-1 day')
      AND DATE(lt.term_end) >= DATE(c.first_term_start, '+' || p.period || ' years', '-1 day')
    WHERE lt.id_bioguide IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.period
)
SELECT
    p.period,
    COALESCE(r.retained, 0) AS retained_legislators,
    cs.total AS cohort_size,
    ROUND(COALESCE(r.retained, 0)*1.0/cs.total, 4) AS retention_rate
FROM periods p
CROSS JOIN cohort_size cs
LEFT JOIN retention r ON p.period = r.period
ORDER BY p.period

WITH base_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.pizza_id,
        o.customer_id,
        n.pizza_name,
        o.exclusions,
        o.extras,
        o.order_time,
        CASE 
            WHEN n.pizza_name = 'Meatlovers' THEN 1
            ELSE 2
        END AS assigned_pizza_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders o
    JOIN pizza_names n ON o.pizza_id = n.pizza_id
),
recipe_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        r.pizza_id,
        t.topping_id,
        t.topping_name
    FROM pizza_recipes r
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON ',' || r.toppings || ',' LIKE '%,' || t.topping_id || ',%'
),
order_exclusions AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        t.topping_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders o
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON ',' || ifnull(o.exclusions, '') || ',' LIKE '%,' || t.topping_id || ',%'
),
order_extras AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        t.topping_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders o
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON ',' || ifnull(o.extras, '') || ',' LIKE '%,' || t.topping_id || ',%'
),
order_ingredients AS (
    SELECT 
        bo.order_id,
        bo.customer_id,
        bo.pizza_name,
        bo.order_time,
        rt.topping_name,
        1 as source
    FROM base_orders bo
    LEFT JOIN recipe_toppings rt ON (bo.assigned_pizza_id = rt.pizza_id)
    WHERE rt.topping_name IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        bo.order_id,
        bo.customer_id,
        bo.pizza_name,
        bo.order_time,
        t.topping_name,
        -1 as source
    FROM base_orders bo
    JOIN order_exclusions oe ON bo.order_id = oe.order_id
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON oe.topping_id = t.topping_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        bo.order_id,
        bo.customer_id,
        bo.pizza_name,
        bo.order_time,
        t.topping_name,
        2 as source
    FROM base_orders bo
    JOIN order_extras oe ON bo.order_id = oe.order_id
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON oe.topping_id = t.topping_id
),
agg_ingredients AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_name,
        order_time,
        topping_name,
        SUM(source) as net_count
    FROM order_ingredients
    GROUP BY order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time, topping_name
    HAVING SUM(source) > 0
),
exploded AS (
    SELECT 
        ai.order_id,
        ai.customer_id,
        ai.pizza_name,
        ai.order_time,
        CASE WHEN ai.net_count > 1 THEN '2x' || ai.topping_name ELSE ai.topping_name END as ingr,
        ai.net_count
    FROM agg_ingredients ai
),
sorted_ingredients AS (
    SELECT 
        e.order_id,
        e.customer_id,
        e.pizza_name,
        e.order_time,
        GROUP_CONCAT(e.ingr, ', ') as ingredient_set
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            *,
            CASE WHEN net_count > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as sort_group
        FROM exploded
        ORDER BY order_id, sort_group, ingr
    ) e
    GROUP BY e.order_id, e.customer_id, e.pizza_name, e.order_time
)
SELECT 
    si.order_id, 
    si.customer_id,
    si.pizza_name,
    (si.pizza_name || ': ' || ifnull(si.ingredient_set, '')) AS final_ingredients
FROM sorted_ingredients si
ORDER BY si.order_id ASC;

WITH boundary_dates AS (
    SELECT
        DATE('2020-06-15', '-12 weeks') AS pre_start,
        DATE('2020-06-15', '-1 day') AS pre_end,
        DATE('2020-06-15') AS post_start,
        DATE('2020-06-15', '+11 weeks') AS post_end
),
sales_by_attr_and_period AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        platform,
        age_band,
        demographic,
        customer_type,
        CASE 
            WHEN week_date BETWEEN (SELECT pre_start FROM boundary_dates) AND (SELECT pre_end FROM boundary_dates) THEN 'pre'
            WHEN week_date BETWEEN (SELECT post_start FROM boundary_dates) AND (SELECT post_end FROM boundary_dates) THEN 'post'
        END AS period,
        SUM(sales) AS total_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales, boundary_dates
    WHERE week_date BETWEEN (SELECT pre_start FROM boundary_dates) AND (SELECT post_end FROM boundary_dates)
    GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type, period
),
sales_pct_change_by_attrvalue AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        platform,
        age_band,
        demographic,
        customer_type,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'pre' THEN total_sales END),0) AS pre_sales,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'post' THEN total_sales END),0) AS post_sales,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'pre' THEN total_sales END) > 0
            THEN 100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'post' THEN total_sales END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'pre' THEN total_sales END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'pre' THEN total_sales END)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS pct_change
    FROM sales_by_attr_and_period
    GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type
),
attribute_type_avg_change AS (
    SELECT 'region' AS attribute_type, AVG(pct_change) AS avg_pct_change FROM (SELECT region, AVG(pct_change) AS pct_change FROM sales_pct_change_by_attrvalue WHERE region IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'platform', AVG(pct_change) FROM (SELECT platform, AVG(pct_change) AS pct_change FROM sales_pct_change_by_attrvalue WHERE platform IS NOT NULL GROUP BY platform)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'age_band', AVG(pct_change) FROM (SELECT age_band, AVG(pct_change) AS pct_change FROM sales_pct_change_by_attrvalue WHERE age_band IS NOT NULL GROUP BY age_band)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'demographic', AVG(pct_change) FROM (SELECT demographic, AVG(pct_change) AS pct_change FROM sales_pct_change_by_attrvalue WHERE demographic IS NOT NULL GROUP BY demographic)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'customer_type', AVG(pct_change) FROM (SELECT customer_type, AVG(pct_change) AS pct_change FROM sales_pct_change_by_attrvalue WHERE customer_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_type)
)
SELECT
    attribute_type,
    avg_pct_change,
    CASE WHEN avg_pct_change = (
        SELECT MIN(avg_pct_change)
        FROM attribute_type_avg_change
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_highest_negative_impact
FROM attribute_type_avg_change
ORDER BY is_highest_negative_impact DESC, avg_pct_change ASC;

WITH label_weeks AS (
  SELECT
    week_date,
    CASE 
      WHEN week_date >= '2020-03-23' AND week_date <= '2020-06-07' THEN 'before'
      WHEN week_date >= '2020-06-15' AND week_date <= '2020-08-31' THEN 'after'
      ELSE NULL
    END as period
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date BETWEEN '2020-03-23' AND '2020-08-31'
  GROUP BY week_date
),
attr_types AS (
  SELECT 'region' as attr UNION ALL
  SELECT 'platform' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'age_band' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'demographic' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'customer_type'
),
attrs_sales AS (
  SELECT 'region' as attr_type, region as attr_value, l.period, SUM(sales) as total_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales s 
    JOIN label_weeks l ON s.week_date = l.week_date
    WHERE l.period IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY region, l.period
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'platform', platform, l.period, SUM(sales) 
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales s 
    JOIN label_weeks l ON s.week_date = l.week_date 
    WHERE l.period IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY platform, l.period
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'age_band', age_band, l.period, SUM(sales) 
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales s 
    JOIN label_weeks l ON s.week_date = l.week_date 
    WHERE l.period IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY age_band, l.period
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'demographic', demographic, l.period, SUM(sales) 
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales s 
    JOIN label_weeks l ON s.week_date = l.week_date 
    WHERE l.period IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY demographic, l.period
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'customer_type', customer_type, l.period, SUM(sales) 
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales s 
    JOIN label_weeks l ON s.week_date = l.week_date 
    WHERE l.period IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY customer_type, l.period
),
attrs_pivot AS (
  SELECT 
    attr_type, attr_value,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period='before' THEN total_sales END) as before_sales,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period='after' THEN total_sales END) as after_sales
  FROM attrs_sales
  GROUP BY attr_type, attr_value
),
attr_pct_change AS (
  SELECT 
    attr_type,
    attr_value,
    before_sales,
    after_sales,
    CASE 
      WHEN before_sales>0 THEN CAST(after_sales-before_sales AS REAL)/before_sales
      ELSE NULL
    END as pct_change
  FROM attrs_pivot
)
SELECT attr_type, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
FROM attr_pct_change
GROUP BY attr_type
ORDER BY avg_pct_change ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH daily_deliveries AS (
    SELECT
        d.driver_id,
        DATE(del.completed_at) AS delivery_date,
        COUNT(*) AS deliveries_per_day
    FROM deliveries del
    JOIN drivers d ON d.id = del.driver_id
    GROUP BY d.driver_id, DATE(del.completed_at)
),
avg_daily_deliveries AS (
    SELECT
        driver_id,
        AVG(deliveries_per_day) AS avg_deliveries_per_day
    FROM daily_deliveries
    GROUP BY driver_id
)
SELECT
    dr.id AS driver_id,
    dr.name,
    avg_daily_deliveries.avg_deliveries_per_day
FROM avg_daily_deliveries
JOIN drivers dr ON dr.id = avg_daily_deliveries.driver_id
ORDER BY avg_daily_deliveries.avg_deliveries_per_day DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH filtered_events AS (
  SELECT
    sce.product_id,
    sce.event_type,
    sce.page_id,
    sce.cart_id
  FROM shopping_cart_events sce
  WHERE sce.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
),
event_counts AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS view_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'add_to_cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS add_to_cart_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'purchase' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_count
  FROM filtered_events
  GROUP BY product_id
),
abandoned_carts AS (
  -- products in cart without a purchase event for the cart
  SELECT
    e.product_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.cart_id) AS abandoned_count
  FROM filtered_events e
  WHERE e.event_type = 'add_to_cart'
    AND e.cart_id NOT IN (
      SELECT cart_id
      FROM filtered_events
      WHERE event_type = 'purchase'
    )
  GROUP BY e.product_id
)
SELECT
  ec.product_id,
  ec.view_count,
  ec.add_to_cart_count,
  COALESCE(a.abandoned_count, 0) AS abandoned_cart_count,
  ec.purchase_count
FROM event_counts ec
LEFT JOIN abandoned_carts a ON ec.product_id = a.product_id
ORDER BY ec.product_id;

SELECT 
    a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name AS actor_full_name
FROM actor a
JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id
JOIN film f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id
JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN language l ON f.language_id = l.language_id
WHERE 
    l.name = 'English'
    AND c.name = 'Children'
    AND f.rating IN ('G', 'PG')
    AND f.length <= 120
    AND f.release_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
order_totals AS (
    SELECT
        do.customer_id,
        do.order_id,
        do.order_purchase_timestamp,
        SUM(oi.price + IFNULL(oi.freight_value,0)) AS order_amount
    FROM delivered_orders do
    JOIN order_items oi ON do.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY do.customer_id, do.order_id, do.order_purchase_timestamp
),
rfm_base AS (
    SELECT
        ot.customer_id,
        COUNT(ot.order_id) AS frequency,
        SUM(ot.order_amount) AS monetary,
        MAX(ot.order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_order_ts
    FROM order_totals ot
    GROUP BY ot.customer_id
),
recency_calc AS (
    SELECT
        rb.*,
        JULIANDAY((SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) FROM delivered_orders)) - JULIANDAY(rb.last_order_ts) AS recency
    FROM rfm_base rb
),
rfm_scores AS (
    SELECT
        rc.customer_id,
        rc.frequency,
        rc.monetary,
        rc.recency,
        -- Recency: lower is better (1 = most recent, 5 = least recent)
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY rc.recency ASC) AS recency_score,
        -- Frequency: higher is better (1 = most frequent, 5 = least frequent)
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY rc.frequency DESC) AS frequency_score,
        -- Monetary: higher is better (1 = highest spending, 5 = lowest)
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY rc.monetary DESC) AS monetary_score
    FROM recency_calc rc
),
rfm_segments AS (
    SELECT
        rs.*,
        (rs.frequency_score + rs.monetary_score) AS fm_sum,
        CASE
            WHEN rs.recency_score = 1 AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
            WHEN (rs.recency_score IN (4,5)) AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can\'t Lose Them'
            WHEN (rs.recency_score IN (4,5)) AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
            WHEN (rs.recency_score IN (4,5)) AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
            WHEN (rs.recency_score IN (2,3)) AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
            WHEN rs.recency_score = 3 AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
            WHEN rs.recency_score = 1 AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
            WHEN (rs.recency_score = 1 AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 5 AND 6)
                 OR (rs.recency_score = 2 AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
            WHEN rs.recency_score = 1 AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
            WHEN rs.recency_score = 2 AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
            WHEN rs.recency_score = 3 AND rs.fm_sum BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS rfm_segment
    FROM rfm_scores rs
),
avg_sales_per_order AS (
    SELECT
        rs.customer_id,
        rs.rfm_segment,
        rs.monetary * 1.0 / rs.frequency AS avg_sales_per_order
    FROM rfm_segments rs
    WHERE rs.frequency > 0
)
SELECT
    rfm_segment,
    COUNT(customer_id) AS num_customers,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_sales_per_order),2) AS avg_sales_per_order,
    MIN(avg_sales_per_order) AS min_avg_sales,
    MAX(avg_sales_per_order) AS max_avg_sales
FROM avg_sales_per_order
GROUP BY rfm_segment
ORDER BY 
    CASE rfm_segment
       WHEN 'Champions' THEN 1
       WHEN 'Loyal Customers' THEN 2
       WHEN 'Potential Loyalists' THEN 3
       WHEN 'Recent Users' THEN 4
       WHEN 'Needs Attention' THEN 5
       WHEN 'Promising' THEN 6
       WHEN 'Can''t Lose Them' THEN 7
       WHEN 'About to Sleep' THEN 8
       WHEN 'Hibernating' THEN 9
       WHEN 'Lost' THEN 10
       WHEN 'Price Sensitive' THEN 11
       ELSE 99
    END;

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
customer_order_stats AS (
    SELECT
        do.customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT do.order_id) AS frequency,
        MAX(do.order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_purchase,
        SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS monetary
    FROM delivered_orders do
    JOIN order_items oi ON do.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY do.customer_id
),
reference_date AS (
    -- Use latest delivered order as the reference for recency calculation
    SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS max_date FROM delivered_orders
),
customer_rfm_raw AS (
    SELECT
        cos.customer_id,
        JULIANDAY((SELECT max_date FROM reference_date)) - JULIANDAY(cos.last_purchase) AS recency_days,
        cos.frequency,
        cos.monetary
    FROM customer_order_stats cos
),
rfm_scores AS (
    -- Assign R, F, M scores (1 = best, 5 = worst) using quintiles
    SELECT
        r.*,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY recency_days ASC) AS recency_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY frequency DESC) AS frequency_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY monetary DESC) AS monetary_score
    FROM customer_rfm_raw r
),
rfm_segments AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        (recency_score) || (frequency_score) || (monetary_score) AS rfm_cell,
        CASE
            -- Champions
            WHEN recency_score = 1 AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4
                THEN 'Champions'
            -- Can't Lose Them
            WHEN (recency_score = 4 OR recency_score = 5) AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 2
                THEN "Can't Lose Them"
            -- Hibernating
            WHEN (recency_score = 4 OR recency_score = 5) AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 3 AND 6
                THEN 'Hibernating'
            -- Lost
            WHEN (recency_score = 4 OR recency_score = 5) AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10
                THEN 'Lost'
            -- Loyal Customers
            WHEN (recency_score = 2 OR recency_score = 3) AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4
                THEN 'Loyal Customers'
            -- Needs Attention
            WHEN recency_score = 3 AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6
                THEN 'Needs Attention'
            -- Recent Users
            WHEN recency_score = 1 AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 8
                THEN 'Recent Users'
            -- Potential Loyalists
            WHEN (recency_score = 1 AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6)
               OR (recency_score = 2 AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 8)
                THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
            -- Price Sensitive
            WHEN recency_score = 1 AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10
                THEN 'Price Sensitive'
            -- Promising
            WHEN recency_score = 2 AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10
                THEN 'Promising'
            -- About to Sleep
            WHEN recency_score = 3 AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10
                THEN 'About to Sleep'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS rfm_segment
    FROM rfm_scores
),
customer_avg_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_unique_id,
        r.rfm_segment,
        r.monetary,
        r.frequency,
        CASE WHEN r.frequency > 0 THEN CAST(r.monetary AS FLOAT)/r.frequency ELSE NULL END AS avg_sales_per_order
    FROM rfm_segments r
    JOIN customers c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id
)
SELECT
    rfm_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customer_count,
    AVG(avg_sales_per_order) AS avg_sales_per_order
FROM customer_avg_sales
WHERE rfm_segment != 'Other'
GROUP BY rfm_segment
ORDER BY avg_sales_per_order DESC;

WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS year_month,
    SUM(amount) AS monthly_sales,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', order_date)) AS month_num
  FROM orderlines
  JOIN orders ON orderlines.order_id = orders.order_id
  WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
    AND order_date >= '2016-01-01'
    AND order_date < '2019-01-01'
  GROUP BY product_id, year_month
),
-- Step 1: Calculate Centered Moving Average (CMA) for each month (window: 5 before + 6 after and 6 before + 5 after)
cma_calc AS (
  SELECT
    sd1.product_id,
    sd1.year_month,
    sd1.month_num,
    sd1.monthly_sales,
    (
      -- Average of two overlapping 12-month windows centered at current month
      (
        COALESCE((SELECT AVG(monthly_sales)
                  FROM sales_data sd2
                  WHERE sd2.product_id = sd1.product_id AND sd2.month_num BETWEEN (sd1.month_num-5) AND (sd1.month_num+6)), 0)
      +
        COALESCE((SELECT AVG(monthly_sales)
                  FROM sales_data sd3
                  WHERE sd3.product_id = sd1.product_id AND sd3.month_num BETWEEN (sd1.month_num-6) AND (sd1.month_num+5)), 0)
      )/2.0 AS cma
    FROM sales_data sd1
),
-- Step 2: Restrict to months 7 - 30 for seasonality/ratio modeling
seasonality_range AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    (monthly_sales / NULLIF(cma,0)) AS sales_to_cma_ratio
  FROM cma_calc
  WHERE month_num BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),
-- Step 3: Estimate seasonality multiplicative index for each of 12 calendar months (using average sales-to-CMA ratio)
seasonality_index AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    CAST(substr(year_month,6,2) AS INTEGER) as month_num_in_year,
    AVG(sales_to_cma_ratio) AS seasonality_factor
  FROM seasonality_range
  GROUP BY product_id, month_num_in_year
),
-- Step 4: Prepare regressor input (dependent: monthly_sales / seasonality_factor, independent: time index)
deseasonalized AS (
  SELECT
    sr.product_id,
    sr.month_num,
    sr.monthly_sales / NULLIF(si.seasonality_factor,0) AS deseasonalized_sales
  FROM seasonality_range sr
  JOIN seasonality_index si
    ON sr.product_id = si.product_id
   AND CAST(substr(sr.year_month,6,2) AS INTEGER) = si.month_num_in_year
),
-- Step 5: Regression coefficients (weighted regression: weight is seasonality factor)
regression_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.product_id,
    COUNT(*) as N,
    SUM(month_num) as Sx,
    SUM(deseasonalized_sales) as Sy,
    SUM(month_num * deseasonalized_sales) as Sxy,
    SUM(month_num * month_num) as Sxx
  FROM deseasonalized d
  GROUP BY d.product_id
),
regression_coeffs AS (
  SELECT
    r.product_id,
    -- Intercept (a): (Sy*Sxx - Sx*Sxy) / (N*Sxx - Sx*Sx)
    (r.Sy * r.Sxx - r.Sx * r.Sxy) * 1.0 / NULLIF((r.N * r.Sxx - r.Sx * r.Sx),0) AS intercept,
    -- Slope (b): (N*Sxy - Sx*Sy) / (N*Sxx - Sx*Sx)
    (r.N * r.Sxy - r.Sx * r.Sy) * 1.0 / NULLIF((r.N * r.Sxx - r.Sx * r.Sx),0) AS slope
  FROM regression_stats r
),
-- Step 6: Forecast for 2018 (months 25~36, i.e. Jan~Dec 2018 since starting from Jan 2016), add back seasonality
forecast_months AS (
  SELECT product_id, (m + 24) AS month_num_2018, m AS forecast_month
  FROM (SELECT 1 m UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6
        UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12)
),
-- join monthly seasonality index for each forecast month
forecast_with_seasonality AS (
  SELECT
    fm.product_id,
    fm.forecast_month,
    rc.intercept + rc.slope * fm.month_num_2018 AS forecast_deseasonalized,
    si.seasonality_factor,
    (rc.intercept + rc.slope * fm.month_num_2018) * si.seasonality_factor AS forecasted_sales
  FROM forecast_months fm
  JOIN regression_coeffs rc ON rc.product_id = fm.product_id
  JOIN seasonality_index si
    ON si.product_id = fm.product_id
   AND si.month_num_in_year = fm.forecast_month
)
-- Step 7: Compute average forecasted annual sales for 2018 for each product
SELECT
  product_id,
  AVG(forecasted_sales) AS avg_forecasted_annual_sales_2018
FROM forecast_with_seasonality
GROUP BY product_id

WITH abakan_airports AS (
    SELECT airport_code
    FROM airports_data
    WHERE city = 'Abakan'
),
routes AS (
    SELECT 
        f.departure_airport AS airport1,
        f.arrival_airport AS airport2
    FROM flights f
    WHERE f.departure_airport IN (SELECT airport_code FROM abakan_airports)
       OR f.arrival_airport IN (SELECT airport_code FROM abakan_airports)
),
unique_routes AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN a1.city < a2.city THEN a1.city ELSE a2.city END AS city1,
        CASE WHEN a1.city < a2.city THEN a2.city ELSE a1.city END AS city2,
        a1.airport_code AS airport1, a2.airport_code AS airport2,
        a1.latitude_deg AS lat1, a1.longitude_deg AS lon1,
        a2.latitude_deg AS lat2, a2.longitude_deg AS lon2
    FROM routes r
    JOIN airports_data a1 ON r.airport1 = a1.airport_code
    JOIN airports_data a2 ON r.airport2 = a2.airport_code
),
city_pairs AS (
    SELECT city1, city2, lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2
    FROM unique_routes
    GROUP BY city1, city2
),
distances AS (
    SELECT
        city1, city2,
        2 * 6371 * 
        ASIN(
            SQRT(
                POWER(SIN(RADIANS((lat2 - lat1) / 2)), 2) +
                COS(RADIANS(lat1)) * COS(RADIANS(lat2)) *
                POWER(SIN(RADIANS((lon2 - lon1) / 2)), 2)
            )
        ) AS distance_km
    FROM city_pairs
    WHERE city1 = 'Abakan' OR city2 = 'Abakan'
)
SELECT MAX(distance_km) AS longest_route_km
FROM distances;

WITH abakan_airports AS (
  SELECT airport_code
  FROM airports_data
  WHERE json_extract(city, '$.en') = 'Abakan'
),
relevant_flights AS (
  SELECT flight_no, departure_airport, arrival_airport
  FROM flights
  WHERE departure_airport IN (SELECT airport_code FROM abakan_airports)
     OR arrival_airport IN (SELECT airport_code FROM abakan_airports)
),
airports_with_coords AS (
  SELECT airport_code, json_extract(city, '$.en') AS city,
         CAST(substr(coordinates, 2, instr(coordinates, ',')-2) AS FLOAT) AS longitude,
         CAST(substr(coordinates, instr(coordinates, ',')+1, length(coordinates)-instr(coordinates, ',')-1) AS FLOAT) AS latitude
  FROM airports_data
),
flights_with_coords AS (
  SELECT
    f.flight_no,
    da.city AS departure_city, da.latitude AS dep_lat, da.longitude AS dep_lon,
    aa.city AS arrival_city, aa.latitude AS arr_lat, aa.longitude AS arr_lon
  FROM relevant_flights f
  JOIN airports_with_coords da ON f.departure_airport = da.airport_code
  JOIN airports_with_coords aa ON f.arrival_airport = aa.airport_code
),
city_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN departure_city < arrival_city THEN departure_city ELSE arrival_city END AS city1,
    CASE WHEN departure_city < arrival_city THEN arrival_city ELSE departure_city END AS city2,
    dep_lat, dep_lon, arr_lat, arr_lon
  FROM flights_with_coords
  GROUP BY city1, city2
),
distances AS (
  SELECT city1, city2,
    2 * 6371 * asin(
      sqrt(
        pow(sin(radians((arr_lat - dep_lat) / 2)), 2) + 
        cos(radians(dep_lat)) * cos(radians(arr_lat)) * 
        pow(sin(radians((arr_lon - dep_lon) / 2)), 2)
      )
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM city_pairs
  WHERE city1 = 'Abakan' OR city2 = 'Abakan'
)
SELECT MAX(distance_km) AS longest_route_distance_km FROM distances
LIMIT 1

  FROM
    (SELECT * FROM sales_by_city_quarter WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1772) q19

linreg AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS n,
        SUM(CAST(julianday(sales_date) - julianday('2017-01-01') AS INT)) AS sum_x,
        SUM(total_sales) AS sum_y,
        SUM(CAST(julianday(sales_date) - julianday('2017-01-01') AS INT) * total_sales) AS sum_xy,
        SUM((CAST(julianday(sales_date) - julianday('2017-01-01') AS INT)) * (CAST(julianday(sales_date) - julianday('2017-01-01') AS INT))) AS sum_x2
    FROM daily_sales
),
predict_dates(date) AS (
    VALUES ('2018-12-05'),('2018-12-06'),('2018-12-07'),('2018-12-08'),
           ('2018-12-03'),('2018-12-04'),('2018-12-09'),('2018-12-10')
),
predicted_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        pd.date, 
        lr.n, lr.sum_x, lr.sum_y, lr.sum_xy, lr.sum_x2,
        CAST(julianday(pd.date) - julianday('2017-01-01') AS INT) AS x
    FROM predict_dates pd CROSS JOIN linreg lr
),
predicted_toy_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        date,
        (
            (sum_xy - (sum_x * sum_y) / n) / (sum_x2 - (sum_x * sum_x) / n)
        ) AS slope,
        (
            (sum_y - (
                (sum_xy - (sum_x * sum_y) / n) / (sum_x2 - (sum_x * sum_x) / n)
            ) * sum_x) / n
        ) AS intercept,
        x,
        (
            (
                (sum_xy - (sum_x * sum_y) / n) / (sum_x2 - (sum_x * sum_x) / n)
            ) * x + 
            ((sum_y - (
                (sum_xy - (sum_x * sum_y) / n) / (sum_x2 - (sum_x * sum_x) / n)
            ) * sum_x) / n)
        ) AS predicted_sales

daily_sales AS (

        SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE oi.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM toy_products)
      AND date(o.order_purchase_timestamp) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-08-29'
      AND o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
    GROUP BY sale_date
),
date_series AS (
    SELECT date('2017-01-01', '+' || (n) || ' days') AS series_date
    FROM (
        SELECT row_number() OVER () - 1 AS n
        FROM (SELECT 1 FROM orders LIMIT 600)
    )
    WHERE series_date BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-08-29'
),
regression_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS n,
        SUM(x) AS sum_x,
        SUM(y) AS sum_y,
        SUM(x * y) AS sum_xy,
        SUM(x * x) AS sum_xx
    FROM (
        SELECT
            CAST(julianday(ds.series_date) - julianday('2017-01-01') AS INTEGER) AS x,
            COALESCE(ds2.total_sales, 0) AS y
        FROM date_series ds
        LEFT JOIN daily_sales ds2 ON ds.series_date = ds2.sale_date
    )
),
regression_coeffs AS (
    SELECT
        (sum_xy - (sum_x * sum_y) * 1.0 / n) / (sum_xx - (sum_x * sum_x) * 1.0 / n) AS b,
        (sum_y - ((sum_xy - (sum_x * sum_y) * 1.0 / n) / (sum_xx - (sum_x * sum_x) * 1.0 / n)) * sum_x) * 1.0 / n AS a
    FROM regression_stats
),
predict_dates AS (
    SELECT date('2018-12-05', '+' || n || ' days') AS pred_date
    FROM (SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3)
),
symmetric_window AS (
    SELECT pd.pred_date, date(pd.pred_date, '-' || offset || ' days') AS window_date
    FROM predict_dates pd
    JOIN (SELECT -2 AS offset UNION ALL SELECT -1 UNION ALL SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2) off
),
date_x_values AS (
    SELECT
        window_date,
        CAST(julianday(window_date) - julianday('2017-01-01') AS INTEGER) AS x
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT window_date FROM symmetric_window
    )
),
window_predictions AS (
    SELECT
        sw.pred_date,
        sw.window_date,
        rc.a + rc.b * dx.x AS predicted_sales
    FROM symmetric_window sw
    JOIN date_x_values dx ON sw.window_date = dx.window_date
    CROSS JOIN regression_coeffs rc
),
moving_avg_5d AS (

WITH first_five_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, lap
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE lap BETWEEN 1 AND 5
),
driver_lap_positions AS (
    SELECT
        lp.race_id,
        lp.lap,
        lp.driver_id,
        lp.position,
        LAG(lp.position) OVER (
            PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap
        ) as prev_position
    FROM lap_positions lp
    JOIN first_five_laps ffl ON lp.race_id = ffl.race_id AND lp.lap = ffl.lap
),
potential_overtakes AS (
    SELECT
        dl1.race_id,
        dl1.lap,
        dl1.driver_id AS overtaker_id,
        dl1.position AS overtaker_pos,
        dl2.driver_id AS overtaken_id,
        dl2.position AS overtaken_pos,
        dl1.prev_position AS overtaker_prev,
        dl2.prev_position AS overtaken_prev
    FROM driver_lap_positions dl1
    JOIN driver_lap_positions dl2
        ON dl1.race_id = dl2.race_id
        AND dl1.lap = dl2.lap
        AND dl1.position + 1 = dl2.position
        AND dl1.prev_position > dl2.prev_position
    WHERE dl1.prev_position IS NOT NULL AND dl2.prev_position IS NOT NULL
),
retirements_lap AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap FROM retirements WHERE lap IS NOT NULL
),
pitstops_thislap AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap FROM pit_stops
),
pitstops_prev_lap AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap+1 AS lap FROM pit_stops
),
grid_positions AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, grid FROM results
),
overtake_classified AS (
    SELECT
        po.race_id,
        po.lap,
        CASE
            -- Retirement
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM retirements_lap r
                WHERE r.race_id = po.race_id AND r.driver_id = po.overtaken_id AND r.lap = po.lap
            ) THEN 'R'
            -- Pit entry
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM pitstops_thislap p
                WHERE p.race_id = po.race_id AND p.driver_id = po.overtaken_id AND p.lap = po.lap
            ) THEN 'P'
            -- Pit exit
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM pitstops_prev_lap p
                WHERE p.race_id = po.race_id AND p.driver_id = po.overtaken_id AND p.lap = po.lap
            ) THEN 'P'
            -- Start related (lap 1, grid diff <= 2)
            WHEN po.lap = 1 AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM grid_positions g1
                JOIN grid_positions g2
                    ON g1.race_id = g2.race_id
                WHERE g1.race_id = po.race_id
                  AND g1.driver_id = po.overtaker_id
                  AND g2.driver_id = po.overtaken_id
                  AND ABS(g1.grid - g2.grid) <= 2
            ) THEN 'S'
            -- Standard Track Overtake
            ELSE 'T'
        END AS category
    FROM potential_overtakes po
)
SELECT
    category,
    COUNT(*) AS overtake_count
FROM overtake_classified
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category;

WITH monthly_interest_composition AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month,
    interest,
    AVG(CAST(composition AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(index_value,0)) AS avg_composition_index
  FROM interest_metrics
  WHERE date >= '2018-09-01' AND date < '2019-09-01'
  GROUP BY month, interest
),
monthly_max_interest AS (
  SELECT
    a.month,
    a.interest,
    a.avg_composition_index AS max_index_composition
  FROM monthly_interest_composition a
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      month,
      MAX(avg_composition_index) AS max_comp
    FROM monthly_interest_composition
    GROUP BY month
  ) b
    ON a.month = b.month AND a.avg_composition_index = b.max_comp
),
enriched_max_interest AS (
  SELECT
    m1.month,
    m1.interest,
    m1.max_index_composition,
    -- Lag: previous month
    LAG(m1.interest, 1) OVER (ORDER BY m1.month) AS prev_interest_1,
    LAG(m1.max_index_composition, 1) OVER (ORDER BY m1.month) AS prev_max_index_comp_1,
    -- Lag: 2 months ago
    LAG(m1.interest, 2) OVER (ORDER BY m1.month) AS prev_interest_2,
    LAG(m1.max_index_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY m1.month) AS prev_max_index_comp_2,
    -- Rolling 3-month average
    ROUND(AVG(m1.max_index_composition) OVER (ORDER BY m1.month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 6) AS rolling_avg_3m
  FROM monthly_max_interest m1
)
SELECT
  month AS date,
  interest,
  max_index_composition,
  rolling_avg_3m AS rolling_avg_max_index_composition_3m,
  prev_interest_1 AS prev_month_interest,
  prev_max_index_comp_1 AS prev_month_max_index_composition,
  prev_interest_2 AS prev2_month_interest,
  prev_max_index_comp_2 AS prev2_month_max_index_composition

WITH RECURSIVE expanded(packaging_id, leaf_id, total_qty) AS (
  -- Start at each packaging as a root, initially qty = 1
  SELECT
    pr.packaging_id,
    pr.contains_id,
    pr.qty AS total_qty
  FROM packaging_relations pr
  UNION ALL
  -- Expand leafs: if a leaf contains more, expand those
  SELECT
    e.packaging_id,
    pr.contains_id,
    e.total_qty * pr.qty
  FROM expanded e
  JOIN packaging_relations pr ON e.leaf_id = pr.packaging_id
)
, leafs AS (
  -- True leaf nodes are contains_id never acting as packaging_id
  SELECT DISTINCT e.packaging_id, e.leaf_id, SUM(e.total_qty) AS total_qty
  FROM expanded e
  LEFT JOIN packaging_relations pr2 ON e.leaf_id = pr2.packaging_id
  WHERE pr2.packaging_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY e.packaging_id, e.leaf_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_qty) AS avg_total_leaf_qty
FROM (
  SELECT packaging_id, SUM(total_qty) AS total_qty
  FROM leafs
  GROUP BY packaging_id
) t;

WITH RECURSIVE expanded_packaging AS (
  -- Each packaging and the contents it directly contains
  SELECT
    pr.packaging_id AS root_packaging_id,
    pr.contains_id AS leaf_packaging_id,
    pr.qty AS factor
  FROM packaging_relations pr

  UNION ALL

  -- Expand: for each child that is also a parent, go deeper
  SELECT
    ep.root_packaging_id,
    pr.contains_id,
    ep.factor * pr.qty AS factor
  FROM expanded_packaging ep
  JOIN packaging_relations pr ON ep.leaf_packaging_id = pr.packaging_id
)

)

  SELECT ep.root_packaging_id, SUM(ep.factor) AS total_qty
  FROM expanded_packaging ep
  JOIN leaf_packaging l ON ep.leaf_packaging_id = l.contains_id

)

  SELECT

    r.LastName,

      WHEN CAST(r.RankDesc AS FLOAT) / sc.total_students <= 0.6 THEN 'Third'
      WHEN CAST(r.RankDesc AS FLOAT) / sc.total_students <= 0.8 THEN 'Fourth'
      ELSE 'Fifth'
    END AS Quintile
  FROM Ranked r
  CROSS JOIN StudentCount sc

WITH overtakes AS (
  SELECT
    lp.race_id,
    lp.lap,
    lp.position,
    lp.driver_id,
    LAG(lp.position) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap) AS prev_position,
    LAG(lp.lap) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap) AS prev_lap
  FROM lap_positions lp
),
position_changes AS (
  -- Only consider laps beyond the first lap (exclude start movements)
  -- Exclude pit-in/out laps by joining with pit_stops table
  SELECT
    o.race_id,
    o.lap,
    o.driver_id,
    o.prev_position,
    o.position,
    o.prev_lap
  FROM overtakes o
  LEFT JOIN pit_stops ps
    ON o.race_id = ps.race_id AND o.driver_id = ps.driver_id AND (o.lap = ps.lap or o.prev_lap = ps.lap)
  WHERE
    o.prev_lap IS NOT NULL
    AND o.lap > 1
    AND o.prev_position != o.position
    AND ps.driver_id IS NULL -- Exclude pit-in/out laps
),
all_drivers_in_lap AS (
  -- For each lap, find all driver positions before and after
  SELECT
    lp.race_id,
    lp.lap,
    lp.driver_id,
    lp.position
  FROM lap_positions lp
  WHERE lp.lap > 1
),
position_gains AS (
  -- Who overtook whom (i.e., a driver moving ahead of another)
  SELECT
    pc.race_id,
    pc.lap,
    pc.driver_id AS overtaker_id,
    pc.prev_position,
    pc.position,
    adil.driver_id AS overtaken_id
  FROM position_changes pc
  JOIN all_drivers_in_lap adil
    ON pc.race_id = adil.race_id
    AND pc.lap = adil.lap
    AND adil.driver_id != pc.driver_id
    AND pc.prev_position > adil.position -- Was behind previously
    AND pc.position <= adil.position -- Is now ahead or on same spot
),
overtake_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d1.driver_id,
    d1.forename || ' ' || d1.surname AS full_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT (pg.race_id || '_' || pg.lap || '_' || pg.overtaken_id)) AS overtakes_made
  FROM drivers d1
  LEFT JOIN position_gains pg
    ON d1.driver_id = pg.overtaker_id
  GROUP BY d1.driver_id
),
being_overtaken_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d1.driver_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT (pg.race_id || '_' || pg.lap || '_' || pg.overtaker_id)) AS overtakes_suffered
  FROM drivers d1
  LEFT JOIN position_gains pg
    ON d1.driver_id = pg.overtaken_id
  GROUP BY d1.driver_id
)
SELECT
  ods.full_name
FROM overtake_stats ods
JOIN being_overtaken_stats bos
  ON ods.driver_id = bos.driver_id
WHERE bos.overtakes_suffered > ods.overtakes_made
ORDER BY ods.full_name;

WITH filtered_lap_times AS (
  SELECT lt.race_id, lt.driver_id, lt.lap, lt.position
  FROM lap_times lt
  WHERE lt.lap > 1
),
valid_lap_times AS (
  SELECT flt.*
  FROM filtered_lap_times flt
  LEFT JOIN pit_stops ps
    ON flt.race_id = ps.race_id
    AND flt.driver_id = ps.driver_id
    AND flt.lap = ps.lap
  LEFT JOIN retirements r
    ON flt.race_id = r.race_id
    AND flt.driver_id = r.driver_id
    AND flt.lap = r.lap
  WHERE ps.driver_id IS NULL AND r.driver_id IS NULL
),
overtakes AS (
  SELECT
    prev.driver_id AS overtaken_id,
    curr.driver_id AS overtaker_id
  FROM valid_lap_times prev
  JOIN valid_lap_times curr
    ON prev.race_id = curr.race_id
    AND prev.lap = curr.lap
    AND prev.position = curr.position + 1
),
overtaken_count AS (
  SELECT overtaken_id AS driver_id, COUNT(*) AS overtaken_events
  FROM overtakes
  GROUP BY overtaken_id
),
overtaker_count AS (
  SELECT overtaker_id AS driver_id, COUNT(*) AS overtaker_events
  FROM overtakes
  GROUP BY overtaker_id
)
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM drivers d
LEFT JOIN overtaken_count oc ON d.driver_id = oc.driver_id

WHERE IFNULL(oc.overtaken_events, 0) > IFNULL(ok.overtaker_events, 0);

    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(ch, '') FROM (
      SELECT SUBSTR(word, n, 1) AS ch
      FROM (
        WITH RECURSIVE chars(n) AS (
          SELECT 1
          UNION ALL
          SELECT n+1 FROM chars WHERE n < LENGTH(word)
        )
        SELECT n FROM chars
      )
      ORDER BY ch
    )) AS anagram_key
  FROM filtered_words
),
anagram_counts AS (
  SELECT
    w1.word,
    w1.len,
    w1.anagram_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT w2.word) AS anagram_count
  FROM word_anagram_keys w1
  JOIN word_anagram_keys w2
    ON w1.anagram_key = w2.anagram_key
    AND w1.len = w2.len
    AND w1.word <> w2.word
  GROUP BY w1.word, w1.len, w1.anagram_key
)
SELECT
  word,
  anagram_count
FROM anagram_counts
ORDER BY word
LIMIT 10;

  FROM word_list
  WHERE LENGTH(words) IN (4,5) AND words GLOB 'r*'

word_sigs AS (
  SELECT word, LENGTH(word) as len, 
         (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c, '') FROM (
           SELECT SUBSTR(word, n, 1) as c
           FROM (SELECT 1 as n UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5) numbers
           WHERE n <= LENGTH(word)
           ORDER BY c
         )) AS signature
  FROM filtered_words
),
anagram_counts AS (
  SELECT signature, COUNT(*) as anagram_count
  FROM word_sigs
  GROUP BY signature
),
results AS (
  SELECT ws.word, ac.anagram_count
  FROM word_sigs ws
  JOIN anagram_counts ac ON ws.signature = ac.signature
  WHERE ac.anagram_count > 1
)

FROM results
ORDER BY word
LIMIT 10;

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_hierarchy AS (
  -- Start from all top-level packaging (not inside any other packaging)
  SELECT
    p.id AS top_packaging_id,
    p.name AS top_packaging_name,
    pr.contains_id AS packaging_id,
    pr.qty AS multiplier
  FROM packaging p
  JOIN packaging_relations pr ON p.id = pr.packaging_id
  WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)

  UNION ALL

  -- Traverse deeper into the hierarchy, multiplying quantities
  SELECT
    ph.top_packaging_id,
    ph.top_packaging_name,
    pr.contains_id,
    ph.multiplier * pr.qty
  FROM packaging_hierarchy ph
  JOIN packaging_relations pr ON ph.packaging_id = pr.packaging_id
)
, packaging_to_product AS (
  -- Find products directly contained in lowest-level packaging
  SELECT
    ph.top_packaging_id,
    ph.top_packaging_name,
    inv.product_id,
    ph.multiplier * inv.qty AS total_qty
  FROM packaging_hierarchy ph
  JOIN inventory inv ON ph.packaging_id = inv.id
)
, total_qty_accumulated AS (
  -- Aggregate quantity for each top-level packaging and product
  SELECT
    top_packaging_id,
    top_packaging_name,
    product_id,
    SUM(total_qty) AS accumulated_qty
  FROM packaging_to_product
  GROUP BY top_packaging_id, top_packaging_name, product_id
)
SELECT
  tqa.top_packaging_name AS packaging_name,
  prod.name AS product_name,
  tqa.accumulated_qty
FROM total_qty_accumulated tqa
JOIN products prod ON tqa.product_id = prod.id
WHERE tqa.accumulated_qty > 500
ORDER BY tqa.top_packaging_name, prod.name;

WITH driver_race_appearances AS (
    SELECT
        d.driverId,
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        r.year,
        r.round,
        results.constructorId,
        r.raceId
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results ON d.driverId = results.driverId
    JOIN races r ON results.raceId = r.raceId
),
driver_year_races AS (
    SELECT
        driverId,
        year,
        GROUP_CONCAT(round, ',') AS appeared_rounds,
        COUNT(DISTINCT round) AS num_appearances
    FROM driver_race_appearances
    GROUP BY driverId, year
),
all_race_rounds AS (
    SELECT
        r.year,
        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.round, ',') AS all_rounds,
        COUNT(DISTINCT r.round) AS total_rounds
    FROM races r
    GROUP BY r.year
),
driver_missed_ranges AS (
    -- Find missed round ranges per driver per year, only where missed count < 3
    SELECT
        dra.driverId,
        dra.year,
        arr.all_rounds,
        dra.appeared_rounds,
        arr.total_rounds - dra.num_appearances AS num_missed,
        -- Parse rounds into arrays for later processing (first, last missed)
        arr.all_rounds AS all_rounds_csv,
        dra.appeared_rounds AS appeared_rounds_csv
    FROM driver_year_races dra
    JOIN all_race_rounds arr ON dra.year = arr.year
    WHERE (arr.total_rounds - dra.num_appearances) > 0 AND (arr.total_rounds - dra.num_appearances) < 3
),
expanded_missed_rounds AS (
    -- Expand missed rounds for each driver/year
    SELECT
        dmr.driverId,
        dmr.year,
        CAST(value AS INTEGER) AS missed_round
    FROM driver_missed_ranges dmr
    JOIN (
        SELECT
            driverId,
            year,
            all_rounds_csv,
            appeared_rounds_csv,
            -- split rounds into rows: for each round in all_rounds, if not in appeared_rounds, yield it
            substr(all_rounds_csv,
                instr(all_rounds_csv, ',') * (n - 1) + 1,
                CASE
                    WHEN instr(substr(all_rounds_csv || ',', instr(all_rounds_csv, ',') * (n - 1) + 1), ',') = 0 THEN length(all_rounds_csv)
                    ELSE instr(substr(all_rounds_csv || ',', instr(all_rounds_csv, ',') * (n - 1) + 1), ',') - 1
                END
            ) AS value
        FROM driver_missed_ranges
        JOIN (
            SELECT 1 as n UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7
            UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14
            UNION SELECT 15 UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20
            -- max races per year is 20 (should be enough)
        )
        WHERE n <= (length(all_rounds_csv) - length(REPLACE(all_rounds_csv, ',', ''))+1)
    ) AS rounds_split
    WHERE value NOT IN (SELECT value FROM (
        SELECT
            substr(appeared_rounds_csv,
                instr(appeared_rounds_csv, ',') * (n2 - 1) + 1,
                CASE
                    WHEN instr(substr(appeared_rounds_csv || ',', instr(appeared_rounds_csv, ',') * (n2 - 1) + 1), ',') = 0
                    THEN length(appeared_rounds_csv)
                    ELSE instr(substr(appeared_rounds_csv || ',', instr(appeared_rounds_csv, ',') * (n2 - 1) + 1), ',') - 1
                END
            ) AS value
        FROM (
            SELECT *
            FROM driver_missed_ranges AS t1
            WHERE t1.driverId = driver_missed_ranges.driverId AND t1.year = driver_missed_ranges.year
        ), (
            SELECT 1 AS n2 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION
            SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14
            UNION SELECT 15 UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20
        )
        WHERE n2 <= (length(appeared_rounds_csv) - length(REPLACE(appeared_rounds_csv, ',', ''))+1)
    ))
        AND value != '' AND value IS NOT NULL
),
driver_missed_ranges_final AS (
    -- collapse to one missed range per driver/year
    SELECT
        emr.driverId,
        emr.year,
        MIN(emr.missed_round) AS first_missed_round,
        MAX(emr.missed_round) AS last_missed_round
    FROM expanded_missed_rounds emr
    GROUP BY emr.driverId, emr.year
),
edge_constructor_switch AS (
    -- For each missed range, check constructor before/after missed races
    SELECT
        dmr.driverId,
        dmr.year,
        dmr.first_missed_round,
        dmr.last_missed_round,
        -- Get constructorId right before first missed
        (
            SELECT constructorId
            FROM driver_race_appearances dra
            WHERE dra.driverId = dmr.driverId
              AND dra.year = dmr.year
              AND dra.round = dmr.first_missed_round - 1
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS before_constructorId,
        -- Get constructorId right after last missed
        (
            SELECT constructorId
            FROM driver_race_appearances dra
            WHERE dra.driverId = dmr.driverId
              AND dra.year = dmr.year
              AND dra.round = dmr.last_missed_round + 1
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS after_constructorId
    FROM driver_missed_ranges_final dmr
    WHERE
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM driver_race_appearances dra
            WHERE dra.driverId = dmr.driverId AND dra.year = dmr.year AND dra.round = dmr.first_missed_round - 1
        )
        AND
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM driver_race_appearances dra
            WHERE dra.driverId = dmr.driverId AND dra.year = dmr.year AND dra.round = dmr.last_missed_round + 1
        )
)
SELECT
    AVG(first_missed_round * 1.0) AS avg_first_missed_round,
    AVG(last_missed_round * 1.0) AS avg_last_missed_round
FROM edge_constructor_switch
WHERE before_constructorId IS NOT NULL AND after_constructorId IS NOT NULL AND before_constructorId != after_constructorId;

WITH driver_race_team AS (
    SELECT
        res.driver_id,
        r.year,
        r.round,
        r.race_id,
        res.constructor_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY res.driver_id, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY res.driver_id, r.year) AS num_entries
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
),
all_driver_seasons AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT driver_id, year
    FROM results
    JOIN races ON results.race_id = races.race_id
),
race_list AS (
    SELECT r.race_id, r.year, r.round FROM races r
),
missed_races AS (
    SELECT
        ads.driver_id,
        ads.year,
        rl.round
    FROM all_driver_seasons ads
    JOIN race_list rl ON rl.year = ads.year
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT driver_id, year, round FROM driver_race_team
    ) drt ON drt.driver_id = ads.driver_id AND drt.year = ads.year AND drt.round = rl.round
    WHERE drt.round IS NULL
),
grouped_missed AS (
    SELECT
        driver_id,
        year,
        round,
        round - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY driver_id, year ORDER BY round) AS grp
    FROM missed_races
),
missed_ranges AS (
    SELECT
        driver_id,
        year,
        MIN(round) AS first_missed_round,
        MAX(round) AS last_missed_round,
        COUNT(*) AS num_missed
    FROM grouped_missed
    GROUP BY driver_id, year, grp
),
filtered_ranges AS (
    SELECT * FROM missed_ranges
    WHERE num_missed < 3
),
before_after_team_switches AS (
    SELECT
        fr.*,
        (SELECT constructor_id FROM driver_race_team drt WHERE drt.driver_id = fr.driver_id AND drt.year = fr.year AND drt.round = fr.first_missed_round - 1 ORDER BY drt.round DESC LIMIT 1) AS before_constructor,
        (SELECT constructor_id FROM driver_race_team drt WHERE drt.driver_id = fr.driver_id AND drt.year = fr.year AND drt.round = fr.last_missed_round + 1 ORDER BY drt.round ASC LIMIT 1) AS after_constructor
    FROM filtered_ranges fr
),
team_switch_hiatuses AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM before_after_team_switches
    WHERE before_constructor IS NOT NULL
      AND after_constructor IS NOT NULL
      AND before_constructor <> after_constructor
)
SELECT
    AVG(first_missed_round * 1.0) AS avg_first_missed_round,
    AVG(last_missed_round * 1.0) AS avg_last_missed_round
FROM team_switch_hiatuses;

WITH order_details AS (
    SELECT
        ol.product_id,
        ol.qty AS ordered_qty,
        ol.orderline_id
    FROM orderlines ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_id = 423
    ORDER BY ol.product_id, ol.orderline_id
),
order_lines_cum AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        orderline_id,
        ordered_qty,
        SUM(ordered_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY orderline_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_order_qty
    FROM order_details
),
inv_by_loc AS (
    SELECT
        s.product_id,
        s.aisle,
        s.position,
        s.qty AS available_qty,
        i.purchase_date
    FROM stock s
    JOIN inventory i ON s.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    WHERE s.warehouse_id = 1 AND s.qty > 0
),
inv_priority AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY i.purchase_date, s.qty) AS inv_priority_order
    FROM stock s
    JOIN inventory i ON s.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    WHERE s.warehouse_id = 1 AND s.qty > 0
),
product_inv AS (
    SELECT
        s.product_id,
        s.aisle,
        s.position,
        s.qty AS available_qty,
        i.purchase_date,
        SUM(s.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY s.product_id ORDER BY i.purchase_date, s.qty ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_inv_qty,
        s.inventory_id
    FROM stock s
    JOIN inventory i ON s.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    WHERE s.warehouse_id = 1 AND s.qty > 0
),
assigned_picking AS (
    SELECT
        olc.product_id,
        olc.orderline_id,
        olc.ordered_qty,
        olc.cum_order_qty,
        pi.aisle,
        pi.position,
        pi.purchase_date,
        pi.available_qty,
        pi.inventory_id,
        pi.cum_inv_qty,
        -- Calculate how much needs to be picked from this inventory location for this order line
        -- This is the overlap between what is needed for this order line (up to cum_order_qty)
        -- and what is available at this inventory location (up to cum_inv_qty)
        MAX(0,
            MIN(
                pi.cum_inv_qty,
                olc.cum_order_qty
            ) - 
            MAX(
                pi.cum_inv_qty - pi.available_qty,
                olc.cum_order_qty - olc.ordered_qty
            )
        ) AS pick_qty
    FROM order_lines_cum olc
    JOIN product_inv pi ON olc.product_id = pi.product_id
    WHERE MIN(
            pi.cum_inv_qty,
            olc.cum_order_qty
        ) - 
        MAX(
            pi.cum_inv_qty - pi.available_qty,
            olc.cum_order_qty - olc.ordered_qty
        ) > 0
),
final_pick AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        orderline_id,
        aisle,
        position,
        purchase_date,
        pick_qty
    FROM assigned_picking
    WHERE pick_qty > 0
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    orderline_id,
    aisle,
    position,
    pick_qty
FROM final_pick
ORDER BY product_id, orderline_id, purchase_date, pick_qty;

WITH intervals AS (
  SELECT 0 as interval_years UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 UNION ALL
  SELECT 4 UNION ALL
  SELECT 6 UNION ALL
  SELECT 8 UNION ALL
  SELECT 10
),
first_terms AS (
  -- For each legislator, find their first term's start date and the state
  SELECT
    lt.legislator_id,
    MIN(lt.start_date) AS first_start_date,
    lt.state,
    l.gender
  FROM legislators_terms lt
  JOIN legislators l ON lt.legislator_id = l.id
  GROUP BY lt.legislator_id
),
retention_points AS (
  -- Build a row for each interval and legislator with snapshot dates
  SELECT
    ft.legislator_id,
    ft.state,
    ft.gender,
    i.interval_years,
    date(ft.first_start_date, printf('+%d years', i.interval_years)) as snapshot_date
  FROM first_terms ft
  CROSS JOIN intervals i
),
active_at_snapshot AS (
  -- Check if the legislator was serving on that snapshot date
  SELECT
    rp.legislator_id,
    rp.state,
    rp.gender,
    rp.interval_years,
    CASE 
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt
        WHERE lt.legislator_id = rp.legislator_id
          AND lt.start_date <= rp.snapshot_date
          AND (lt.end_date IS NULL OR lt.end_date >= rp.snapshot_date)
      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END as retained
  FROM retention_points rp
),
retention_rates AS (
  -- For each state/gender/interval, get denominator and number retained
  SELECT
    aa.state,
    aa.gender,
    aa.interval_years,
    COUNT(DISTINCT aa.legislator_id) AS total,
    SUM(aa.retained) AS retained_count,
    1.0 * SUM(aa.retained) / COUNT(DISTINCT aa.legislator_id) AS retention_rate
  FROM active_at_snapshot aa
  GROUP BY aa.state, aa.gender, aa.interval_years
),
retention_check AS (
  -- For each state/gender, require retention_rate > 0 at all 6 intervals
  SELECT
    state,
    gender
  FROM retention_rates
  WHERE retention_rate > 0
  GROUP BY state, gender
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT interval_years) = 6
),
both_genders AS (
  -- Only the states with both genders passing the filter
  SELECT
    state
  FROM retention_check
  GROUP BY state
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gender) = 2
)
SELECT DISTINCT state
FROM both_genders
ORDER BY state;

WITH legislator_cohorts AS (
  SELECT
    lg.id_bioguide,
    lg.gender,
    lt.state,
    MIN(DATE(lt.term_start)) AS first_term_start
  FROM legislators lg
  JOIN legislators_terms lt ON lg.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
  WHERE lg.gender IN ('male', 'female')
  GROUP BY lg.id_bioguide, lt.state, lg.gender
),
intervals AS (
  SELECT 0 AS years UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
cohort_intervals AS (
  SELECT
    lc.id_bioguide,
    lc.gender,
    lc.state,
    DATE(lc.first_term_start, '+' || intervals.years || ' years') AS interval_date,
    intervals.years
  FROM legislator_cohorts lc
  CROSS JOIN intervals
),
served_on_interval AS (
  SELECT
    ci.id_bioguide,
    ci.gender,
    ci.state,
    ci.years,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt
      WHERE lt.id_bioguide = ci.id_bioguide
        AND lt.state = ci.state
        AND DATE(lt.term_start) <= DATE(ci.interval_date, '-1 day')
        AND DATE(lt.term_end) > DATE(ci.interval_date, '-1 day')
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained
  FROM cohort_intervals ci
),
retention_by_state_gender_years AS (
  SELECT
    state,
    gender,
    years,
    AVG(retained) AS retention_rate
  FROM served_on_interval
  GROUP BY state, gender, years
),
passing_states AS (
  SELECT
    state,
    gender
  FROM retention_by_state_gender_years
  WHERE retention_rate > 0
  GROUP BY state, gender
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT years) = 6
)
SELECT DISTINCT p1.state AS state_abbreviation
FROM passing_states p1
JOIN passing_states p2 ON p1.state = p2.state AND p1.gender = 'male' AND p2.gender = 'female'
ORDER BY state_abbreviation;

WITH
-- Get minimum required inventory per product
product_min AS (
  SELECT product_id, minimum
  FROM product_minimums
),
-- December 2018 ending inventory per product
dec18_inventory AS (
  SELECT
    s.product_id,
    SUM(s.quantity) AS end_inventory
  FROM stock s
  WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', s.date) = '2018-12'
  GROUP BY s.product_id
),
-- Get all orders per product/month in 2019
order_outflow AS (
  SELECT
    o.product_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', ord.order_date) AS ym,
    SUM(o.quantity) AS sold_qty
  FROM orderlines o
  JOIN orders ord ON o.order_id = ord.order_id
  WHERE strftime('%Y', ord.order_date) = '2019'
  GROUP BY o.product_id, ym
),
-- Generate months in 2019
months AS (
  SELECT '2019-01' AS ym UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-02' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-03' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-04' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-05' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-06' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-07' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-08' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-09' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-10' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-11' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2019-12'
),
-- Prepare inventory calculation per product/month recursively
inventory_sim AS (
  -- Anchor: Jan 2019, start from Dec 2018 end_inventory
  SELECT
    pm.product_id,
    m.ym,
    COALESCE(d.end_inventory, 0) AS begin_inventory,
    pm.minimum,
    COALESCE(o.sold_qty, 0) AS sold_qty,
    CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS restocked_qty,
    NULL AS end_inventory
  FROM product_min pm
  CROSS JOIN months m
  LEFT JOIN dec18_inventory d ON pm.product_id = d.product_id
  LEFT JOIN order_outflow o ON pm.product_id = o.product_id AND m.ym = '2019-01'
  WHERE m.ym = '2019-01'

  UNION ALL

  -- Recursive: from previous month's result
  SELECT
    inv.product_id,
    m.ym,
    -- previous month's ending inventory
    inv.end_inventory,
    inv.minimum,
    COALESCE(o.sold_qty, 0) AS sold_qty,
    CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS restocked_qty,
    NULL AS end_inventory
  FROM inventory_sim inv
  JOIN months m
    ON julianday(m.ym || '-01') = julianday(inv.ym || '-01', '+1 month')
  LEFT JOIN order_outflow o ON inv.product_id = o.product_id AND m.ym = m.ym
)
,
-- Actually calculate restocked_amt and simulated ending inventory
rec_inventory_sim AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    ym,
    begin_inventory,
    minimum,
    sold_qty,
    -- If after outflow, ending inventory < minimum, restock by the difference
    CASE
      WHEN (begin_inventory - sold_qty) < minimum THEN minimum - (begin_inventory - sold_qty)
      ELSE 0
    END AS restocked_qty,
    -- Simulated ending inventory after restock
    (CASE
      WHEN (begin_inventory - sold_qty) < minimum THEN minimum
      ELSE (begin_inventory - sold_qty)
    END) AS end_inventory
  FROM (
    SELECT *,
      -- Use LAG window to plug in previously-calced end_inventory as the begin_inventory for next month
      LAG(end_inventory) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY ym) as lagged_end_inventory
    FROM (
      -- Replace begin_inventory for months > '2019-01' with lagged value from recursive CTE
      SELECT *, 
        CASE WHEN ym = '2019-01' THEN begin_inventory ELSE NULL END as true_begin_inventory
      FROM inventory_sim
    )
  )
  -- Replace NULL begin_inventory with lagged value (from window function) for months after Jan
  -- so each month uses previous ending inventory
)
,
-- Recurse across all 12 months by joining previous month, so that begin_inventory flows
recursive_full AS (
  -- Jan 2019: Use Dec 2018 for begin_inventory
  SELECT
    pm.product_id,
    m.ym,
    COALESCE(di.end_inventory,0) AS begin_inventory,
    pm.minimum,
    COALESCE(o.sold_qty,0) AS sold_qty
  FROM product_min pm
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT ym FROM months WHERE ym = '2019-01') m
  LEFT JOIN dec18_inventory di ON pm.product_id=di.product_id
  LEFT JOIN order_outflow o ON pm.product_id = o.product_id AND o.ym=m.ym

  UNION ALL

  -- All next months
  SELECT
    rf.product_id,
    m_next.ym,
    -- begin_inventory = last month's end_inventory
    (CASE
      WHEN ((rf.begin_inventory - rf.sold_qty)<rf.minimum)
        THEN rf.minimum
        ELSE (rf.begin_inventory - rf.sold_qty)
    END) AS begin_inventory,
    rf.minimum,
    COALESCE(o.sold_qty,0) AS sold_qty
  FROM recursive_full rf
  JOIN months m_next ON julianday(m_next.ym||'-01')=julianday(rf.ym||'-01','+1 month')
  LEFT JOIN order_outflow o ON rf.product_id=o.product_id AND o.ym=m_next.ym
  WHERE m_next.ym>'2019-01'
),
-- Calculate post-sale, post-restock inventory per month
ending_inventory AS (
  SELECT
    rf.product_id,
    rf.ym,
    rf.begin_inventory,
    rf.sold_qty,
    rf.minimum,
    -- Add restock if under minimum; else zero
    CASE
      WHEN (rf.begin_inventory - rf.sold_qty) < rf.minimum THEN rf.minimum - (rf.begin_inventory - rf.sold_qty)
      ELSE 0
    END AS restocked,
    -- Ending inventory after possible restock
    CASE
      WHEN (rf.begin_inventory - rf.sold_qty) < rf.minimum THEN rf.minimum
      ELSE (rf.begin_inventory - rf.sold_qty)
    END AS end_inventory
  FROM recursive_full rf
)
,
abs_diff_per_month AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    ym,
    ABS(end_inventory - minimum) AS abs_diff
  FROM ending_inventory
)
,
min_diff_month AS (
  SELECT
    a.product_id,
    a.ym,
    a.abs_diff,
    -- Rank months for each product by the smallest abs_diff
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.product_id ORDER BY a.abs_diff, a.ym) as rn
  FROM abs_diff_per_month a
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  ym AS best_month,
  abs_diff
FROM min_diff_month
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY product_id;

  ROUND((after.total_sales - before.total_sales)*100.0 / before.total_sales, 2) AS pct_change
FROM
  (SELECT * FROM agg_sales WHERE period = 'before') before
  JOIN
  (SELECT * FROM agg_sales WHERE period = 'after') after
  ON before.year = after.year
ORDER BY before.year;

WITH factor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y', collision_date) AS year,
    primary_collision_factor_violation_category,
    COUNT(*) AS incident_count
  FROM collisions
  GROUP BY year, primary_collision_factor_violation_category
),
total_counts AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y', collision_date) AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS total_incidents
  FROM collisions
  GROUP BY year
),
factor_shares AS (
  SELECT
    f.year,
    f.primary_collision_factor_violation_category AS category,
    1.0 * f.incident_count / t.total_incidents * 100 AS pct_share
  FROM factor_counts f
  JOIN total_counts t
    ON f.year = t.year
)
, top_category_2021 AS (
  SELECT category
  FROM factor_shares
  WHERE year = '2021'
  ORDER BY pct_share DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  fs2021.pct_share - fs2011.pct_share AS percentage_point_decrease
FROM factor_shares fs2021
JOIN factor_shares fs2011
  ON fs2021.category = fs2011.category
JOIN top_category_2021 tc
  ON fs2021.category = tc.category
WHERE fs2021.year = '2021' AND fs2011.year = '2011'
;

WITH incident_counts AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y', collision_date) AS year,
    pcf_violation_category,
    COUNT(*) AS incident_count
  FROM collisions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', collision_date) IN ('2011', '2021')
  GROUP BY year, pcf_violation_category
),
year_totals AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    SUM(incident_count) AS total_incidents
  FROM incident_counts
  GROUP BY year
),
category_shares AS (
  SELECT
    ic.year,
    ic.pcf_violation_category,
    ic.incident_count,
    yt.total_incidents,

  FROM incident_counts ic
  JOIN year_totals yt ON ic.year = yt.year
),
most_common_2021 AS (
  SELECT
    pcf_violation_category
  FROM category_shares
  WHERE year = '2021'
  ORDER BY share_percent DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
shares_2011_2021 AS (
  SELECT
    cs.year,
    cs.share_percent
  FROM category_shares cs
  JOIN most_common_2021 mc ON cs.pcf_violation_category = mc.pcf_violation_category
  WHERE cs.year IN ('2011', '2021')
  ORDER BY cs.year
)
SELECT
  (SELECT share_percent FROM shares_2011_2021 WHERE year = '2021') -
  (SELECT share_percent FROM shares_2011_2021 WHERE year = '2011') AS percentage_point_change

WITH txn_dates AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        MIN(date) AS min_date,
        MAX(date) AS max_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
calendar AS (
    SELECT
        t.customer_id,
        date(
            t.min_date,
            printf('+%d day', n)
        ) AS calendar_date,
        t.min_date,
        t.max_date
    FROM txn_dates t
    JOIN (
        SELECT
            a.customer_id,
            b.n
        FROM txn_dates a
        JOIN (
            SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3
            UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7
            UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11
            UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
            UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19
            UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23
            UNION ALL SELECT 24 UNION ALL SELECT 25 UNION ALL SELECT 26 UNION ALL SELECT 27
            UNION ALL SELECT 28 UNION ALL SELECT 29 UNION ALL SELECT 30 UNION ALL SELECT 31
            UNION ALL SELECT 32 UNION ALL SELECT 33 UNION ALL SELECT 34 UNION ALL SELECT 35
            UNION ALL SELECT 36 UNION ALL SELECT 37 UNION ALL SELECT 38 UNION ALL SELECT 39
            UNION ALL SELECT 40 UNION ALL SELECT 41 UNION ALL SELECT 42 UNION ALL SELECT 43
            UNION ALL SELECT 44 UNION ALL SELECT 45 UNION ALL SELECT 46 UNION ALL SELECT 47
            UNION ALL SELECT 48 UNION ALL SELECT 49
        ) b
        WHERE b.n <= julianday(a.max_date) - julianday(a.min_date)
    ) x ON t.customer_id = x.customer_id
),
txns AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        date,
        SUM(amount) AS net_txn
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, date
),
full_calendar AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.calendar_date
    FROM calendar c
),
balance_calc AS (
    SELECT
        fc.customer_id,
        fc.calendar_date,
        COALESCE(tx.net_txn, 0) AS net_txn
    FROM full_calendar fc
    LEFT JOIN txns tx
      ON fc.customer_id = tx.customer_id
     AND fc.calendar_date = tx.date
),
-- Recursive running balance
running_balance AS (
    -- Anchor (first day, balance is that day's net_txn)
    SELECT
        b.customer_id,
        b.calendar_date,
        b.net_txn AS balance
    FROM balance_calc b
    WHERE b.calendar_date = (
        SELECT MIN(c2.calendar_date)
        FROM balance_calc c2
        WHERE c2.customer_id = b.customer_id
    )
    UNION ALL
    -- Recursion: add today's net_txn to yesterday's balance
    SELECT
        b.customer_id,
        b.calendar_date,
        CASE WHEN (r.balance + b.net_txn) < 0 THEN 0 ELSE (r.balance + b.net_txn) END AS balance
    FROM balance_calc b
    JOIN running_balance r
      ON b.customer_id = r.customer_id
     AND date(b.calendar_date) = date(r.calendar_date, '+1 day')
)
,
-- For each customer and month, pick max daily
monthly_max_balance AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', calendar_date) AS month,
        MAX(CASE WHEN balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE balance END) AS max_daily_balance
    FROM running_balance
    GROUP BY customer_id, month
)
SELECT
    month,
    SUM(max_daily_balance) AS monthly_total_max_daily_balances
FROM monthly_max_balance
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

WITH txn_dates AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        MIN(txn_date) AS min_date,
        MAX(txn_date) AS max_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
    SELECT
        td.customer_id,
        date(td.min_date, '+' || n.n || ' day') AS day
    FROM txn_dates td
    JOIN (
        SELECT a.n * 100 + b.n * 10 + c.n AS n
        FROM (SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) a
        CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) b
        CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) c
    ) n
    WHERE date(td.min_date, '+' || n.n || ' day') <= td.max_date
),
txn_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        txn_amount
    FROM customer_transactions
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT
        ad.customer_id,
        ad.day,
        COALESCE(ta.txn_amount, 0) AS txn_amount
    FROM all_dates ad
    LEFT JOIN txn_amounts ta
        ON ad.customer_id = ta.customer_id AND ad.day = ta.txn_date
),
running_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        day,
        MAX(0, 
            SUM(txn_amount) OVER (
                PARTITION BY customer_id
                ORDER BY day
                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
            )
        ) AS daily_balance
    FROM daily_balances
),
month_max_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', day) AS year_month,
        MAX(daily_balance) AS max_daily_balance_in_month
    FROM running_balances
    GROUP BY customer_id, year_month
)
SELECT
    year_month,
    SUM(max_daily_balance_in_month) AS monthly_total_max_balance
FROM month_max_balances
GROUP BY year_month
ORDER BY year_month;
