WITH txn AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        DATE(txn_date) AS txn_date,
        amount,
        transaction_type
    FROM customer_transactions
),
signed_txn AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        CASE
            WHEN transaction_type = 'deposit' THEN amount
            ELSE -amount
        END AS net_amount
    FROM txn
),
days AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        txn_date
    FROM signed_txn
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
calendar AS (
    -- Produce every date from first to last transaction per customer
    SELECT
        d.customer_id,
        dd.txn_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            customer_id,
            MIN(txn_date) AS min_date,
            MAX(txn_date) AS max_date
        FROM signed_txn
        GROUP BY customer_id
    ) d
    JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT txn_date
        FROM signed_txn
    ) dd
    ON dd.txn_date BETWEEN d.min_date AND d.max_date
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM signed_txn) c
    WHERE d.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
per_day_txn AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.txn_date,
        COALESCE(SUM(s.net_amount), 0) AS net_amount
    FROM calendar c
    LEFT JOIN signed_txn s
      ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
     AND c.txn_date = s.txn_date
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.txn_date
),
running_balance AS (
    SELECT
        p.customer_id,
        p.txn_date,
        SUM(p2.net_amount) AS balance
    FROM per_day_txn p
    JOIN per_day_txn p2
        ON p.customer_id = p2.customer_id
       AND p2.txn_date <= p.txn_date
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, p.txn_date
),
rolling_30d AS (
    SELECT
        r.customer_id,
        r.txn_date,
        AVG(CASE WHEN rb.balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE rb.balance END) AS rolling_avg_30d
    FROM running_balance r
    JOIN running_balance rb
      ON r.customer_id = rb.customer_id
     AND rb.txn_date BETWEEN DATE(r.txn_date, '-29 days') AND r.txn_date
    GROUP BY r.customer_id, r.txn_date
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 30
),
date_info AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS ym,
        MIN(strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date)) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS baseline_ym
    FROM rolling_30d
),
rolling_with_months AS (
    SELECT
        r.customer_id,
        r.txn_date,
        di.ym,
        di.baseline_ym,
        r.rolling_avg_30d
    FROM rolling_30d r
    JOIN date_info di
      ON r.customer_id = di.customer_id
     AND r.txn_date = di.txn_date
),
max_rolling_by_month AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        ym,
        MAX(rolling_avg_30d) AS max_rolling_avg_30d,
        baseline_ym
    FROM rolling_with_months
    GROUP BY customer_id, ym
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM max_rolling_by_month
    WHERE ym != baseline_ym
)
SELECT
    ym AS month,
    SUM(max_rolling_avg_30d) AS summed_max_rolling_30d_avg_balance
FROM filtered
GROUP BY ym
ORDER BY ym;

WITH ordered_txns AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id, 
    DATE(txn_date) AS txn_date, 
    txn_type, 
    txn_amount
  FROM customer_transactions
),
signed_txns AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id, 
    txn_date, 
    CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END AS amount
  FROM ordered_txns
),
daily_txns AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id, 
    txn_date, 
    SUM(amount) AS daily_net
  FROM signed_txns
  GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
all_days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, txn_date FROM daily_txns
  UNION
  SELECT customer_id, DATE(min_date, '+' || seq || ' day') AS txn_date
  FROM (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date) AS min_date, MAX(txn_date) AS max_date FROM daily_txns GROUP BY customer_id
  ) b
  JOIN (
    SELECT 0 seq UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9
    UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14 UNION SELECT 15 UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19
    UNION SELECT 20 UNION SELECT 21 UNION SELECT 22 UNION SELECT 23 UNION SELECT 24 UNION SELECT 25 UNION SELECT 26 UNION SELECT 27 UNION SELECT 28 UNION SELECT 29
    UNION SELECT 30 UNION SELECT 31 UNION SELECT 32 UNION SELECT 33 UNION SELECT 34 UNION SELECT 35 UNION SELECT 36 UNION SELECT 37 UNION SELECT 38 UNION SELECT 39
    UNION SELECT 40 UNION SELECT 41 UNION SELECT 42 UNION SELECT 43 UNION SELECT 44 UNION SELECT 45 UNION SELECT 46 UNION SELECT 47 UNION SELECT 48 UNION SELECT 49
  ) s
  WHERE DATE(min_date, '+' || seq || ' day') <= max_date
),
daily_balance AS (
  SELECT
    d.customer_id,
    d.txn_date,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT SUM(d2.daily_net)
      FROM daily_txns d2
      WHERE d2.customer_id = d.customer_id AND d2.txn_date <= d.txn_date
    ), 0) AS running_balance
  FROM all_days d
),
windowed_balance AS (
  SELECT
    b1.customer_id,
    b1.txn_date,
    (
      SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN running_balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE running_balance END)
      FROM daily_balance b2
      WHERE b2.customer_id = b1.customer_id
        AND b2.txn_date <= b1.txn_date
        AND b2.txn_date > DATE(b1.txn_date, '-30 days')
    ) AS avg_30d_balance,
    (
      SELECT COUNT(*)
      FROM daily_balance b2
      WHERE b2.customer_id = b1.customer_id
        AND b2.txn_date <= b1.txn_date
        AND b2.txn_date > DATE(b1.txn_date, '-30 days')
    ) AS day_count
  FROM daily_balance b1
),
filtered_avg AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    txn_date,
    CASE WHEN day_count = 30 THEN avg_30d_balance ELSE NULL END AS avg_30d_balance
  FROM windowed_balance
),
first_months AS (
  SELECT customer_id, SUBSTR(MIN(txn_date),1,7) AS first_month FROM daily_balance GROUP BY customer_id
),
monthly_max AS (
  SELECT
    f.customer_id,
    SUBSTR(f.txn_date,1,7) AS month,
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.avg_30d_balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE f.avg_30d_balance END) AS max_30d_avg

WITH city_inserts AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y', created_at) AS year,
        strftime('%m', created_at) AS month,
        COUNT(*) AS monthly_total
    FROM cities
    WHERE (strftime('%m', created_at) IN ('04','05','06'))
      AND (strftime('%Y', created_at) IN ('2021','2022','2023'))
    GROUP BY year, month
),
months AS (
    SELECT '04' AS month UNION ALL
    SELECT '05' UNION ALL
    SELECT '06'
),
years AS (
    SELECT '2021' AS year UNION ALL
    SELECT '2022' UNION ALL
    SELECT '2023'
),
base_grid AS (
    SELECT y.year, m.month
    FROM years y
    CROSS JOIN months m
),
city_counts AS (
    SELECT
        g.year,
        g.month,
        COALESCE(ci.monthly_total, 0) AS monthly_total
    FROM base_grid g
    LEFT JOIN city_inserts ci
        ON g.year = ci.year AND g.month = ci.month
),
running_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c1.year,
        c1.month,
        c1.monthly_total,
        SUM(c2.monthly_total) AS running_total
    FROM city_counts c1
    JOIN city_counts c2
        ON c1.month = c2.month
       AND c2.year <= c1.year
    GROUP BY c1.year, c1.month, c1.monthly_total
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        rt.year,
        rt.month,
        rt.monthly_total,
        rt.running_total,
        LAG(rt.monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY rt.month ORDER BY rt.year) AS prev_monthly_total,
        LAG(rt.running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY rt.month ORDER BY rt.year) AS prev_running_total
    FROM running_totals rt
    WHERE rt.year IN ('2021','2022','2023')
),
final_growth AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        month,
        monthly_total,
        running_total,
        CASE
            WHEN prev_monthly_total IS NULL OR prev_monthly_total = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (monthly_total - prev_monthly_total) / prev_monthly_total, 2)
        END AS yoy_monthly_growth_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN prev_running_total IS NULL OR prev_running_total = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (running_total - prev_running_total) / prev_running_total, 2)
        END AS yoy_running_growth_pct
    FROM final
)
SELECT
    year,
    month,
    monthly_total,
    running_total,
    yoy_monthly_growth_pct,
    yoy_running_growth_pct
FROM final_growth
WHERE year IN ('2022', '2023')
ORDER BY month, year

WITH monthly_cities AS (

    STRFTIME('%Y', insert_date) AS year,
    STRFTIME('%m', insert_date) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS cities_added
  FROM cities
  WHERE STRFTIME('%m', insert_date) IN ('04', '05', '06')
    AND STRFTIME('%Y', insert_date) IN ('2021','2022','2023')
  GROUP BY year, month
),
running_totals AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    year,
    cities_added,
    SUM(cities_added) OVER (
      PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_total
  FROM monthly_cities
),
growth_calc AS (
  SELECT
    rt.year,
    rt.month,
    rt.cities_added,
    rt.running_total,
    LAG(rt.cities_added) OVER (PARTITION BY rt.month ORDER BY rt.year) AS prev_cities_added,
    LAG(rt.running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY rt.month ORDER BY rt.year) AS prev_running_total
  FROM running_totals rt
)

  year,
  CASE month
    WHEN '04' THEN 'April'
    WHEN '05' THEN 'May'
    WHEN '06' THEN 'June'
    ELSE month
  END AS month,
  cities_added AS monthly_total,
  running_total AS cumulative_running_total,
  CASE
    WHEN prev_cities_added IS NOT NULL AND prev_cities_added > 0
      THEN ROUND(100.0 * (cities_added - prev_cities_added) / prev_cities_added, 2)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS yoy_growth_monthly_total_pct,
  CASE
    WHEN prev_running_total IS NOT NULL AND prev_running_total > 0
      THEN ROUND(100.0 * (running_total - prev_running_total) / prev_running_total, 2)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS yoy_growth_cumulative_running_total_pct
FROM growth_calc
WHERE year IN ('2022', '2023')
ORDER BY year, month

WITH
-- Join sales to times, customers, countries to get US, quarter info, and city
sales_with_context AS (
  SELECT
    s.cust_id,
    cu.cust_city AS city,
    s.prod_id,
    s.amount_sold,
    t.calendar_year,
    t.calendar_quarter_number,
    s.promo_id
  FROM sales s
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON cu.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'United States'
    AND ((t.calendar_year = 2019 AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4)
         OR (t.calendar_year = 2020 AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4))
    AND s.promo_id = 0
),

-- City sales per quarter (2019 Q4 and 2020 Q4 only, no promotion)
city_quarter_sales AS (
  SELECT city, calendar_year, SUM(amount_sold) AS total_sales
  FROM sales_with_context
  GROUP BY city, calendar_year
),

-- Select cities with at least 20% increase from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020
cities_growth AS (
  SELECT a.city, a.total_sales AS sales_2019, b.total_sales AS sales_2020
  FROM 
    (SELECT city, total_sales FROM city_quarter_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2019) a
    INNER JOIN 
    (SELECT city, total_sales FROM city_quarter_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020) b
    ON a.city = b.city
  WHERE a.total_sales > 0 AND (b.total_sales - a.total_sales) * 1.0 / a.total_sales >= 0.2
),

-- All relevant sales in those cities in Q4 of 2019 and 2020 (no promotion)
filtered_sales AS (
  SELECT swc.*
  FROM sales_with_context swc
  JOIN cities_growth cg ON swc.city = cg.city
),

-- Product total sales (in all those cities, over both Q4 periods)
product_sales_total AS (
  SELECT prod_id, SUM(amount_sold) AS sales_total
  FROM filtered_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id
),

-- Rank products by overall sales and top 20% cutoff (ties included)
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id, sales_total,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sales_total DESC) AS rnk,
         COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_products
  FROM product_sales_total
),
top_20pct_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id
  FROM ranked_products
  WHERE rnk <= CAST(total_products * 0.2 + 0.9999 AS INTEGER)
),

-- Sales by product per quarter for the top group
top_product_sales_by_year AS (
  SELECT fs.prod_id, fs.calendar_year, SUM(fs.amount_sold) AS prod_sales
  FROM filtered_sales fs
  JOIN top_20pct_products tp ON fs.prod_id = tp.prod_id
  GROUP BY fs.prod_id, fs.calendar_year
),

total_sales_by_year AS (
  SELECT calendar_year, SUM(amount_sold) AS total_sales
  FROM filtered_sales
  GROUP BY calendar_year
),

-- Share of each top product on each year
product_share_by_year AS (
  SELECT tps.prod_id, tps.calendar_year, tps.prod_sales * 1.0 / tsby.total_sales AS share
  FROM top_product_sales_by_year tps
  JOIN total_sales_by_year tsby ON tps.calendar_year = tsby.calendar_year
),

-- Reshape and calculate share changes
product_share_change AS (
  SELECT
    p.prod_id,
    p2019.share AS share_2019,
    p2020.share AS share_2020,
    (p2020.share - p2019.share) AS share_change
  FROM
    (SELECT * FROM product_share_by_year WHERE calendar_year = 2019) p2019
    JOIN (SELECT * FROM product_share_by_year WHERE calendar_year = 2020) p2020
      ON p2019.prod_id = p2020.prod_id
    JOIN products p ON p2019.prod_id = p.prod_id
)
SELECT psc.prod_id, pr.prod_name, psc.share_2019, psc.share_2020, psc.share_change
FROM product_share_change psc
JOIN products pr ON psc.prod_id = pr.prod_id
ORDER BY psc.share_change DESC
LIMIT 1000

WITH match_points AS (

    M.season,
    M.league_id,
    CASE
      WHEN M.home_team_goal > M.away_team_goal THEN M.home_team_api_id
      WHEN M.home_team_goal < M.away_team_goal THEN M.away_team_api_id
      ELSE NULL
    END AS winner_team_id,
    CASE
      WHEN M.home_team_goal > M.away_team_goal THEN M.away_team_api_id
      WHEN M.home_team_goal < M.away_team_goal THEN M.home_team_api_id
      ELSE NULL
    END AS loser_team_id,
    CASE
      WHEN M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal THEN M.home_team_api_id
    END AS tie_home_team_id,
    CASE
      WHEN M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal THEN M.away_team_api_id
    END AS tie_away_team_id
  FROM Match M
),
points_by_team AS (
  SELECT
    mp.season,
    mp.league_id,
    mp.winner_team_id AS team_id,
    3 AS points
  FROM match_points mp
  WHERE mp.winner_team_id IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    mp.season,
    mp.league_id,
    mp.tie_home_team_id AS team_id,
    1 AS points
  FROM match_points mp
  WHERE mp.tie_home_team_id IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    mp.season,
    mp.league_id,
    mp.tie_away_team_id AS team_id,

),
agg_points AS (

champions AS (

WITH city_coords AS (
  SELECT
    geolocation_state,
    geolocation_city,
    geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
    AVG(geolocation_lat) AS avg_lat,
    AVG(geolocation_lng) AS avg_lng
  FROM olist_geolocation
  GROUP BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix
),
ordered_cities AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    LAG(avg_lat) OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, avg_lat, avg_lng
    ) AS prev_lat,
    LAG(avg_lng) OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, avg_lat, avg_lng
    ) AS prev_lng,
    LAG(geolocation_state) OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, avg_lat, avg_lng
    ) AS prev_state,
    LAG(geolocation_city) OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, avg_lat, avg_lng
    ) AS prev_city,
    LAG(geolocation_zip_code_prefix) OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, avg_lat, avg_lng
    ) AS prev_zip
  FROM city_coords
),
distances AS (
  SELECT
    geolocation_state,
    geolocation_city,
    geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
    avg_lat,
    avg_lng,
    prev_state,
    prev_city,
    prev_zip,
    prev_lat,
    prev_lng,
    CASE 
      WHEN prev_lat IS NOT NULL AND prev_lng IS NOT NULL THEN
        6371 * acos(
          cos(radians(avg_lat)) * cos(radians(prev_lat)) *
          cos(radians(prev_lng) - radians(avg_lng)) +
          sin(radians(avg_lat)) * sin(radians(prev_lat))
        )
      ELSE NULL
    END AS distance_km
  FROM ordered_cities
)
SELECT
  prev_state AS city1_state,
  prev_city AS city1_city,
  prev_zip AS city1_zip,
  prev_lat AS city1_lat,
  prev_lng AS city1_lng,
  geolocation_state AS city2_state,
  geolocation_city AS city2_city,
  geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS city2_zip,
  avg_lat AS city2_lat,
  avg_lng AS city2_lng,
  distance_km
FROM distances
WHERE distance_km IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY distance_km DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH ordered_cities AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      geolocation_state,
      geolocation_city,
      geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
      AVG(geolocation_lat) AS geolocation_lat,
      AVG(geolocation_lng) AS geolocation_lng
    FROM olist_geolocation
    GROUP BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix
  )
),
city_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    curr.geolocation_state AS state1,
    curr.geolocation_city AS city1,
    curr.geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip1,
    curr.geolocation_lat AS lat1,
    curr.geolocation_lng AS lng1,
    prev.geolocation_state AS state2,
    prev.geolocation_city AS city2,
    prev.geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip2,
    prev.geolocation_lat AS lat2,
    prev.geolocation_lng AS lng2,
    6371 * ACOS(
      COS(RADIANS(curr.geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(prev.geolocation_lat)) *
      COS(RADIANS(prev.geolocation_lng) - RADIANS(curr.geolocation_lng)) +
      SIN(RADIANS(curr.geolocation_lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(prev.geolocation_lat))
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM ordered_cities curr
  JOIN ordered_cities prev ON curr.rn = prev.rn + 1
)
SELECT
  state1, city1, zip1, lat1, lng1,
  state2, city2, zip2, lat2, lng2,
  distance_km
FROM city_pairs
ORDER BY distance_km DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH female_legislators AS (

  FROM legislators l
  WHERE l.gender = 'F'
),
first_state_per_legislator AS (
  SELECT lt.id_bioguide, lt.state, MIN(lt.term_start) AS first_term_start
  FROM legislators_terms lt
  GROUP BY lt.id_bioguide
),
terms_including_dec31 AS (
  SELECT 
    lt.id_bioguide
  FROM legislators_terms lt
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM (
      SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', lt.term_start) AS INTEGER) AS year_start,
             CAST(strftime('%Y', lt.term_end) AS INTEGER) AS year_end
    ) years,
    (
      SELECT 0 AS offset UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5
      UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10
      UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14 UNION SELECT 15
      UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20
    ) o
    WHERE (year_start + o.offset) BETWEEN year_start AND year_end
      AND (
        DATE((year_start + o.offset) || '-12-31') BETWEEN lt.term_start AND lt.term_end
      )
    LIMIT 1
  )
)

FROM female_legislators fl

WITH monthly_txn AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m-01', transaction_date) AS month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'deposit' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS net_amount
    FROM bitcoin_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, month
),
cumulative_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        month,
        net_amount,
        SUM(net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) AS closing_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month DESC) AS rn_desc
    FROM monthly_txn
),
recent_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        month AS recent_month,
        closing_balance AS recent_balance,
        LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) AS prev_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month DESC) = 1 AS is_most_recent
    FROM cumulative_balances
),
growth_rates AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        recent_month,
        recent_balance,
        prev_balance,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_balance = 0 OR prev_balance IS NULL THEN recent_balance * 100.0
            ELSE ((recent_balance - prev_balance) * 100.0 / prev_balance)
        END AS growth_rate
    FROM recent_balances
    WHERE is_most_recent
),
customer_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS total_customers
    FROM growth_rates
),
high_growth_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS high_growth_customers
    FROM growth_rates
    WHERE growth_rate > 5
)
SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * high_growth_customers / total_customers, 2) AS percent_customers_above_5pct_growth
FROM high_growth_count, customer_count;

),
latest_months AS (

        customer_id,

    FROM

        customer_id,
        latest_month,

        END AS growth_rate
    FROM

WITH valid_wickets AS (
    SELECT
        bb.bowler_id,
        bb.match_id,
        wt.wicket_type
    FROM
        ball_by_ball bb
        JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id AND bb.inning_no = wt.inning_no AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id
    WHERE
        wt.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') -- only include wickets attributed to bowlers
),
runs_conceded_per_ball AS (
    SELECT
        bb.bowler_id,
        bb.match_id,
        bb.over_id,
        bb.ball_id,
        bs.runs AS runs_off_bat
    FROM
        ball_by_ball bb
        JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.inning_no = bs.inning_no AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
),
bowler_overs AS (
    SELECT
        bb.bowler_id,
        bb.match_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT (bb.over_id || '-' || bb.inning_no)) AS overs_bowled,
        COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled
    FROM
        ball_by_ball bb
        JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.inning_no = bs.inning_no AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    WHERE
        bs.runs IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        bb.bowler_id,
        bb.match_id
),
bowler_match_summary AS (
    SELECT
        rc.bowler_id,
        rc.match_id,
        SUM(rc.runs_off_bat) AS total_runs_conceded,
        bo.balls_bowled,
        COUNT(vw.wicket_type) AS wickets_taken
    FROM
        runs_conceded_per_ball rc
        JOIN bowler_overs bo ON rc.bowler_id = bo.bowler_id AND rc.match_id = bo.match_id
        LEFT JOIN valid_wickets vw ON rc.bowler_id = vw.bowler_id AND rc.match_id = vw.match_id
            AND rc.over_id = (SELECT bb2.over_id FROM ball_by_ball bb2 WHERE bb2.match_id = vw.match_id AND bb2.over_id = rc.over_id AND bb2.ball_id = rc.ball_id LIMIT 1)
            AND rc.ball_id = (SELECT bb2.ball_id FROM ball_by_ball bb2 WHERE bb2.match_id = vw.match_id AND bb2.over_id = rc.over_id AND bb2.ball_id = rc.ball_id LIMIT 1)
    GROUP BY
        rc.bowler_id,
        rc.match_id
),
best_bowling_per_match AS (
    SELECT
        bowler_id,
        MAX(wickets_taken) AS max_wickets
    FROM
        bowler_match_summary
    GROUP BY
        bowler_id
),
best_bowling_full AS (
    SELECT
        bms.bowler_id,
        bms.match_id,
        bms.wickets_taken,
        bms.total_runs_conceded,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bms.bowler_id ORDER BY bms.wickets_taken DESC, bms.total_runs_conceded ASC) AS rn
    FROM
        bowler_match_summary bms
        JOIN best_bowling_per_match bbpm
            ON bms.bowler_id = bbpm.bowler_id AND bms.wickets_taken = bbpm.max_wickets
)
SELECT
    p.player_name AS bowler_name,
    SUM(bms.wickets_taken) AS total_wickets,
    ROUND((SUM(bms.total_runs_conceded) * 6.0) / SUM(bms.balls_bowled), 2) AS economy_rate,
    CASE WHEN SUM(bms.wickets_taken) > 0
        THEN ROUND(CAST(SUM(bms.balls_bowled) AS REAL)/SUM(bms.wickets_taken), 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS strike_rate,
    (SELECT CAST(wickets_taken AS TEXT) || '-' || CAST(total_runs_conceded AS TEXT)
        FROM best_bowling_full bbf
        WHERE bbf.bowler_id = bms.bowler_id AND bbf.rn = 1
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS best_bowling
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            bowler_id,
            SUM(total_runs_conceded) AS total_runs_conceded,
            SUM(balls_bowled) AS balls_bowled,
            SUM(wickets_taken) AS wickets_taken
        FROM
            bowler_match_summary
        GROUP BY
            bowler_id
    ) bms
    JOIN player p ON bms.bowler_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY
    bms.bowler_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY
    total_wickets DESC, economy_rate ASC, p.player_name

    inv.location_id,
    inv.available_qty,
    inv.purchase_date,
    inv.fifo_rank,
    -- The picked quantity is the overlapping amount between what the order needs and what the inventory location can provide
    CASE 
      WHEN oe.order_qty <= inv.available_qty THEN oe.order_qty
      ELSE inv.available_qty
    END AS picked_qty
  FROM orderlines_expanded oe
  JOIN inventory_fifo inv
    ON oe.product_id = inv.product_id

)

)

WITH partnership_runs AS (

        bbb.match_id,
        bbb.striker AS player1_id_raw,
        bbb.non_striker AS player2_id_raw,

        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN batsman_scored.batsman_id = bbb.non_striker THEN batsman_scored.runs 
                ELSE 0 
            END
        ) AS non_striker_runs,
        SUM(batsman_scored.runs) + SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN batsman_scored.batsman_id = bbb.non_striker THEN batsman_scored.runs 
                ELSE 0 
            END
        ) AS total_partnership
    FROM
        ball_by_ball bbb
        JOIN batsman_scored ON bbb.match_id = batsman_scored.match_id AND bbb.inning_no = batsman_scored.inning_no AND bbb.over_id = batsman_scored.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = batsman_scored.ball_id
    GROUP BY
        bbb.match_id, bbb.striker, bbb.non_striker
),
partnership_with_scores AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN striker_runs > non_striker_runs THEN player1_id_raw
            WHEN striker_runs < non_striker_runs THEN player2_id_raw
            WHEN striker_runs = non_striker_runs AND player1_id_raw > player2_id_raw THEN player1_id_raw
            ELSE player2_id_raw
        END AS player1_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN striker_runs > non_striker_runs THEN player2_id_raw
            WHEN striker_runs < non_striker_runs THEN player1_id_raw
            WHEN striker_runs = non_striker_runs AND player1_id_raw > player2_id_raw THEN player2_id_raw
            ELSE player1_id_raw
        END AS player2_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN striker_runs > non_striker_runs THEN striker_runs
            WHEN striker_runs < non_striker_runs THEN non_striker_runs
            WHEN striker_runs = non_striker_runs AND player1_id_raw > player2_id_raw THEN striker_runs
            ELSE striker_runs
        END AS player1_runs,
        CASE 
            WHEN striker_runs > non_striker_runs THEN non_striker_runs
            WHEN striker_runs < non_striker_runs THEN striker_runs
            WHEN striker_runs = non_striker_runs AND player1_id_raw > player2_id_raw THEN non_striker_runs
            ELSE non_striker_runs
        END AS player2_runs,
        total_partnership

WITH monthly_product_sales AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_date) AS year_month,
    products.product_id,
    SUM(orderlines.quantity) AS total_sales
  FROM
    orders
    JOIN orderlines ON orders.order_id = orderlines.order_id
    JOIN products ON orderlines.product_id = products.product_id
  WHERE
    orders.order_date >= '2016-01-01'
  GROUP BY
    products.product_id, year_month
),
-- Assign a row number to each (product_id, year_month) partition for time ordering
ordered_sales AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY year_month) AS rn
  FROM
    monthly_product_sales
),
-- For each month, calculate two overlapping 12-month moving averages
cma_calc AS (
  SELECT
    a.product_id,
    a.year_month,
    a.total_sales,
    -- First window: 5 months before (rn-5) to 6 months after (rn+6)
    (SELECT AVG(total_sales)
     FROM ordered_sales z
     WHERE z.product_id = a.product_id AND z.rn BETWEEN a.rn-5 AND a.rn+6
    ) AS cma1,
    -- Second window: 6 months before (rn-6) to 5 months after (rn+5)
    (SELECT AVG(total_sales)
     FROM ordered_sales z
     WHERE z.product_id = a.product_id AND z.rn BETWEEN a.rn-6 AND a.rn+5
    ) AS cma2,
    a.rn
  FROM ordered_sales a
),
-- Take the average of the two CMAs as the final CMA
cma_final AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    year_month,
    total_sales,
    (COALESCE(cma1,0) + COALESCE(cma2,0))/2.0 AS cma,
    rn
  FROM
    cma_calc
),
-- Calculate the sales-to-CMA ratio and restrict to months 7~30 after Jan 2016
ratio_2017 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUBSTR(year_month, 1, 4) AS year,
    SUBSTR(year_month, 6, 2) AS month,
    CASE WHEN cma > 0 THEN total_sales / cma ELSE NULL END AS sales_to_cma_ratio
  FROM
    cma_final
  WHERE
    rn BETWEEN 7 AND 30
    AND year = '2017'
),
product_above_2 AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    COUNT(*) AS months_with_ratio_gt_2
  FROM
    ratio_2017
  WHERE
    sales_to_cma_ratio > 2
  GROUP BY
    product_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 12  -- Must be true for all 12 months of 2017
)
SELECT
  p.product_id,
  p.product_name
FROM
  products p
  JOIN product_above_2 pa2 ON p.product_id = pa2.product_id
ORDER BY
  p.product_id;

    ) AS month_idx

  GROUP BY ms1.product_id, ms1.mth, ms1.year, ms1.month, ms1.sales, ms1.month_idx
),

cma_both AS (
  SELECT
    w1.product_id,
    w1.mth,
    w1.year,
    w1.month,

    w1.month_idx,

WITH Album_Sales AS (
  SELECT
    al.AlbumId,
    ar.ArtistId,
    ar.Name AS ArtistName,
    COALESCE(SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity), 0) AS Sales
  FROM albums al
  JOIN artists ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
  LEFT JOIN invoice_items ii ON al.AlbumId = ii.AlbumId
  GROUP BY al.AlbumId, ar.ArtistId, ar.Name
),
Artist_Sales AS (
  SELECT
    ArtistId,
    ArtistName,
    SUM(Sales) AS TotalSales
  FROM Album_Sales
  GROUP BY ArtistId, ArtistName
),
Top_And_Bottom_Artists AS (
  SELECT ArtistId, ArtistName, TotalSales
  FROM (
    SELECT
      ArtistId,
      ArtistName,
      TotalSales,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSales DESC, ArtistName ASC) AS rn_top,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSales ASC, ArtistName ASC) AS rn_bottom
    FROM Artist_Sales
  )
  WHERE rn_top = 1 OR rn_bottom = 1
),
Relevant_Albums AS (
  SELECT al.AlbumId, al.ArtistId, tba.ArtistName
  FROM albums al
  JOIN Top_And_Bottom_Artists tba ON al.ArtistId = tba.ArtistId
),
Customer_Artist_Spend AS (
  SELECT
    c.CustomerId,
    c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS CustomerName,
    tba.ArtistId,
    tba.ArtistName,
    SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS CustomerArtistSpend
  FROM customers c
  JOIN invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
  JOIN invoice_items ii ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
  JOIN albums al ON ii.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
  JOIN Top_And_Bottom_Artists tba ON al.ArtistId = tba.ArtistId
  GROUP BY c.CustomerId, tba.ArtistId
),
Artist_Avg_Spend AS (
  SELECT
    ArtistName,
    AVG(CustomerArtistSpend) AS AvgSpend
  FROM Customer_Artist_Spend
  GROUP BY ArtistName
),
Difference AS (
  SELECT
    ABS(
      MAX(CASE WHEN ArtistName = (SELECT ArtistName FROM Top_And_Bottom_Artists ORDER BY TotalSales DESC, ArtistName ASC LIMIT 1) THEN AvgSpend END)
      -
      MAX(CASE WHEN ArtistName = (SELECT ArtistName FROM Top_And_Bottom_Artists ORDER BY TotalSales ASC, ArtistName ASC LIMIT 1) THEN AvgSpend END)
    ) AS AbsoluteDifference
  FROM Artist_Avg_Spend
)
SELECT AbsoluteDifference
FROM Difference;

WITH artist_sales AS (
  SELECT ar.ArtistId, ar.Name AS ArtistName, 
         SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS TotalSales
    FROM artists ar
    JOIN albums al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
    JOIN tracks t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
    JOIN invoice_items ii ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
   GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name
),
ranked_artists AS (
  SELECT ArtistId, ArtistName, TotalSales,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSales DESC, ArtistName ASC) AS rk_top,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSales ASC, ArtistName ASC) AS rk_low
    FROM artist_sales
),
top_artist AS (
  SELECT ArtistId, ArtistName FROM ranked_artists WHERE rk_top = 1 LIMIT 1
),
low_artist AS (
  SELECT ArtistId, ArtistName FROM ranked_artists WHERE rk_low = 1 LIMIT 1
),
customer_artist_spending AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerId,
         c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS CustomerName,
         ar.ArtistId,
         ar.Name AS ArtistName,
         SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS AmountSpent
    FROM customers c
    JOIN invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    JOIN invoice_items ii ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
    JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
    JOIN albums al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
    JOIN artists ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
   WHERE ar.ArtistId IN (
     (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist)
     UNION
     (SELECT ArtistId FROM low_artist)
   )
   GROUP BY c.CustomerId, ar.ArtistId
),
top_artist_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(AmountSpent) AS avg_spent
    FROM customer_artist_spending
   WHERE ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist)
),
low_artist_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(AmountSpent) AS avg_spent
    FROM customer_artist_spending
   WHERE ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM low_artist)
)
SELECT 
  ABS(COALESCE((SELECT avg_spent FROM top_artist_avg), 0) - 
      COALESCE((SELECT avg_spent FROM low_artist_avg), 0)) AS avg_spent_difference
;

WITH laps_with_pos AS (
  SELECT
    lt.raceId,
    lt.driverId,
    lt.lap,
    lt.position,
    ls.status AS driver_status
  FROM lap_times lt
  LEFT JOIN results r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId AND lt.driverId = r.driverId
  LEFT JOIN status ls ON r.statusId = ls.statusId
),
overtake_candidates AS (
  -- Identify overtakes: when a driver was ahead of another on previous lap, but now behind
  SELECT
    curr.raceId,
    curr.lap,
    curr.driverId AS overtaker,
    prev.driverId AS overtaken,
    curr.position AS overtaker_pos,
    prev.position AS overtaken_pos,
    curr.driver_status AS overtaker_status,
    prev.driver_status AS overtaken_status
  FROM laps_with_pos curr
  JOIN laps_with_pos prev
    ON curr.raceId = prev.raceId
    AND curr.lap = prev.lap
    AND curr.driverId != prev.driverId
    -- Overtaker is now behind, but wasn't in the prior lap
    -- Get previous lap position for each driver
    JOIN laps_with_pos curr_prevlap
      ON curr.raceId = curr_prevlap.raceId
      AND curr.driverId = curr_prevlap.driverId
      AND curr.lap = curr_prevlap.lap + 1
    JOIN laps_with_pos prev_prevlap
      ON prev.raceId = prev_prevlap.raceId
      AND prev.driverId = prev_prevlap.driverId
      AND prev.lap = prev_prevlap.lap + 1
    -- Overtaker not behind on prior lap (ahead or equal)
    WHERE curr_prevlap.position <= prev_prevlap.position
      -- Overtaker now behind
      AND curr.position > prev.position
),
pit_entries AS (
  -- Find pit entries (drivers who pitted this lap)
  SELECT raceId, driverId, lap
  FROM pit_stops
), 
pit_exits AS (
  -- Find pit exits (drivers who pitted last lap)
  SELECT raceId, driverId, lap+1 AS lap
  FROM pit_stops
),
race_start_grid AS (
  -- Find grid positions of drivers at race start
  SELECT r.raceId, r.driverId, r.grid
  FROM results r
)
SELECT
  label,
  COUNT(*) AS overtake_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.raceId,
    o.lap,
    o.overtaker,
    o.overtaken,
    -- Classification
    CASE
      -- R: Retired this lap
      WHEN o.overtaken_status LIKE '%Retired%'
        AND (SELECT MAX(lap) FROM laps_with_pos l2 WHERE l2.raceId = o.raceId AND l2.driverId = o.overtaken) = o.lap
      THEN 'R'
      -- P: Pit entry - overtaken pitted this lap
      WHEN (SELECT 1 FROM pit_entries pe WHERE pe.raceId = o.raceId AND pe.driverId = o.overtaken AND pe.lap = o.lap) IS NOT NULL
      THEN 'P'
      -- P: Pit exit - overtaken exited last lap
      WHEN (SELECT 1 FROM pit_exits px WHERE px.raceId = o.raceId AND px.driverId = o.overtaken AND px.lap = o.lap) IS NOT NULL
      THEN 'P'
      -- S: Start - first lap, within 2 grid slots
      WHEN o.lap = 1 AND (
        SELECT ABS(g1.grid - g2.grid)
        FROM race_start_grid g1
        JOIN race_start_grid g2 ON g1.raceId = g2.raceId
        WHERE g1.raceId = o.raceId AND g1.driverId = o.overtaker AND g2.driverId = o.overtaken
      ) <= 2
      THEN 'S'
      -- T: Track
      ELSE 'T'
    END AS label
  FROM overtake_candidates o
)
GROUP BY label
ORDER BY label;

WITH lap_data AS (
  SELECT 
    lt.race_id,
    lt.driver_id,
    lt.lap,
    lt.position,
    LAG(lt.position) OVER (PARTITION BY lt.race_id, lt.driver_id ORDER BY lt.lap) AS prev_position
  FROM lap_times lt
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pit_stops ps WHERE ps.race_id = lt.race_id
  )
),
overtake_candidates AS (
  -- Find for each lap and race, position changes indicating a driver is now behind another (new overtake state)
  SELECT
    curr.race_id,
    curr.lap,
    curr.driver_id AS overtaking_driver,
    prev.driver_id AS overtaken_driver,
    curr.position AS curr_position,
    prev.position AS prev_position,
    curr.prev_position AS overtaker_prev_position,
    prev.prev_position AS overtaken_prev_position
  FROM lap_data curr
  JOIN lap_data prev
    ON curr.race_id = prev.race_id
    AND curr.lap = prev.lap
    AND curr.driver_id <> prev.driver_id
    AND curr.position = prev.position + 1 -- curr is now behind prev
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM lap_data pl_curr
    JOIN lap_data pl_prev
      ON pl_curr.race_id = pl_prev.race_id
      AND pl_curr.lap = curr.lap - 1
      AND pl_prev.lap = curr.lap - 1
      AND pl_curr.driver_id = curr.driver_id
      AND pl_prev.driver_id = prev.driver_id
      AND pl_curr.position = pl_prev.position + 1
  )
),
pit_entry_overtakes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    oc.race_id,
    oc.lap,
    oc.overtaking_driver,
    oc.overtaken_driver,
    'P' AS label
  FROM overtake_candidates oc
  INNER JOIN pit_stops ps
    ON ps.race_id = oc.race_id
    AND ps.driver_id = oc.overtaken_driver
    AND ps.lap = oc.lap
),
pit_exit_overtakes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    oc.race_id,
    oc.lap,
    oc.overtaking_driver,
    oc.overtaken_driver,
    'P' AS label
  FROM overtake_candidates oc
  INNER JOIN pit_stops ps
    ON ps.race_id = oc.race_id
    AND ps.driver_id = oc.overtaken_driver
    AND ps.lap = oc.lap - 1
),
retirement_overtakes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    oc.race_id,
    oc.lap,
    oc.overtaking_driver,
    oc.overtaken_driver,
    'R' AS label
  FROM overtake_candidates oc
  INNER JOIN retirements r
    ON r.race_id = oc.race_id
    AND r.driver_id = oc.overtaken_driver
    AND r.lap = oc.lap
),
start_overtakes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    oc.race_id,
    oc.lap,
    oc.overtaking_driver,
    oc.overtaken_driver,
    'S' AS label
  FROM overtake_candidates oc
  INNER JOIN results res_over ON res_over.race_id = oc.race_id AND res_over.driver_id = oc.overtaking_driver
  INNER JOIN results res_ovek ON res_ovek.race_id = oc.race_id AND res_ovek.driver_id = oc.overtaken_driver
  WHERE oc.lap = 1 AND ABS(res_over.grid - res_ovek.grid) <= 2
),
labelled_overtakes AS (
  SELECT race_id, lap, overtaking_driver, overtaken_driver, label FROM retirement_overtakes
  UNION
  SELECT race_id, lap, overtaking_driver, overtaken_driver, label FROM pit_entry_overtakes
  UNION
  SELECT race_id, lap, overtaking_driver, overtaken_driver, label FROM pit_exit_overtakes
  UNION
  SELECT race_id, lap, overtaking_driver, overtaken_driver, label FROM start_overtakes
  UNION
  -- Track overtakes: not classed above
  SELECT
    oc.race_id,
    oc.lap,
    oc.overtaking_driver,
    oc.overtaken_driver,
    'T' AS label
  FROM overtake_candidates oc
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT race_id, lap, overtaking_driver, overtaken_driver FROM retirement_overtakes
    UNION
    SELECT race_id, lap, overtaking_driver, overtaken_driver FROM pit_entry_overtakes
    UNION
    SELECT race_id, lap, overtaking_driver, overtaken_driver FROM pit_exit_overtakes
    UNION
    SELECT race_id, lap, overtaking_driver, overtaken_driver FROM start_overtakes
  ) labelled USING (race_id, lap, overtaking_driver, overtaken_driver)
  WHERE labelled.race_id IS NULL
)
SELECT
  label,
  COUNT(*) AS overtake_count
FROM labelled_overtakes
GROUP BY label
ORDER BY label

WITH best_driver_per_constructor_year AS (
  SELECT
    cs.constructorId,
    r.year,
    MAX(ds.points) AS best_driver_points
  FROM constructor_standings cs
  JOIN driver_standings ds ON cs.raceId = ds.raceId AND cs.constructorId = ds.constructorId
  JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY cs.constructorId, r.year
),
team_points_per_constructor_year AS (
  SELECT
    cs.constructorId,
    r.year,
    SUM(cs.points) AS team_points
  FROM constructor_standings cs
  JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY cs.constructorId, r.year
),
combined_points AS (
  SELECT
    c.constructorId,
    c.year,
    b.best_driver_points,
    t.team_points,
    (b.best_driver_points + t.team_points) AS combined_points
  FROM best_driver_per_constructor_year b
  JOIN team_points_per_constructor_year t
    ON b.constructorId = t.constructorId AND b.year = t.year
  JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = b.constructorId
)
SELECT
  co.name AS constructor_name,
  cp.year,
  cp.combined_points
FROM combined_points cp
JOIN constructors co ON cp.constructorId = co.constructorId
ORDER BY cp.combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH season_final_race AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(round) AS final_round
  FROM races
  GROUP BY year
),
constructor_team_points AS (
  SELECT cs.constructor_id, r.year, cs.points
  FROM constructor_standings cs
  JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
  JOIN season_final_race sfr ON r.year = sfr.year AND r.round = sfr.final_round
),
driver_points AS (
  SELECT d.constructor_id, r.year, ds.driver_id, ds.points
  FROM driver_standings ds
  JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
  JOIN season_final_race sfr ON r.year = sfr.year AND r.round = sfr.final_round
  JOIN drives d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id AND r.year = d.year
),
best_driver_by_constructor AS (
  SELECT constructor_id, year, MAX(points) AS best_driver_points
  FROM driver_points
  GROUP BY constructor_id, year
),
combined_points AS (
  SELECT ctp.constructor_id, ctp.year, ctp.points + COALESCE(bdb.best_driver_points,0) AS combined_pts
  FROM constructor_team_points ctp
  LEFT JOIN best_driver_by_constructor bdb ON ctp.constructor_id = bdb.constructor_id AND ctp.year = bdb.year
)
SELECT c.name AS constructor, cp.year, cp.combined_pts
FROM combined_points cp
JOIN constructors c ON cp.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY cp.combined_pts DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH region_sales AS (
    SELECT
        wr.region_id,
        wr.region_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wo.order_id) AS num_orders,
        SUM(wo.sales_amount) AS total_sales_amount
    FROM web_orders wo
    JOIN web_region wr ON wo.region_id = wr.region_id
    GROUP BY wr.region_id, wr.region_name
),
rep_sales AS (
    SELECT
        wr.region_id,
        ws.sales_rep_id,
        ws.rep_name,
        SUM(wo.sales_amount) AS rep_total_sales_amount
    FROM web_orders wo
    JOIN web_sales_reps ws ON wo.sales_rep_id = ws.sales_rep_id
    JOIN web_region wr ON wo.region_id = wr.region_id
    GROUP BY wr.region_id, ws.sales_rep_id, ws.rep_name
),
region_max AS (
    SELECT
        region_id,
        MAX(rep_total_sales_amount) AS max_rep_sales_amount
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region_id
),
top_reps AS (
    SELECT
        rs.region_id,
        rs.rep_name,
        rs.rep_total_sales_amount
    FROM rep_sales rs
    JOIN region_max rm ON rs.region_id = rm.region_id AND rs.rep_total_sales_amount = rm.max_rep_sales_amount
)
SELECT
    reg.region_name,
    reg.num_orders,
    reg.total_sales_amount,
    tr.rep_name AS top_sales_rep_name,
    tr.rep_total_sales_amount AS top_sales_rep_amount
FROM region_sales reg
LEFT JOIN top_reps tr ON reg.region_id = tr.region_id
ORDER BY reg.region_name, tr.rep_name;

        wr.name AS region_name,
        COUNT(wo.id) AS num_orders,

    LEFT JOIN web_orders wo ON ws.id = wo.account_id
    GROUP BY wr.id, wr.name

    FROM web_region wr
    JOIN web_sales_reps ws ON ws.region_id = wr.id
    LEFT JOIN web_orders wo ON ws.id = wo.account_id
    GROUP BY wr.id, ws.id, ws.name
),
region_max_sales AS (

        MAX(rep_sales_amount) AS max_sales_amount

    GROUP BY region_id
)

    rs.rep_sales_amount

    ON rs.region_id = rms.region_id AND rs.rep_sales_amount = rms.max_sales_amount

WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT
        bb.match_id,
        bb.innings_no,
        bb.over_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) + SUM(COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS total_runs,
        MIN(bb.bowler) AS bowler -- bowler per over (first bowler found for the over)
    FROM
        ball_by_ball bb
        LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
            AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
            AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
            AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id
            AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
            AND bb.over_id = er.over_id
            AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id
    GROUP BY
        bb.match_id,
        bb.innings_no,
        bb.over_id
),
max_over_per_match AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        innings_no,
        over_id,
        bowler,
        total_runs
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY match_id
                ORDER BY total_runs DESC, innings_no, over_id
            ) AS rn
        FROM over_runs
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(total_runs), 2) AS avg_highest_over_total
FROM
    max_over_per_match;
